roles.name: Warrior
roles.description: The Warrior relies on Might (attacks, damage, Warrior class DCs). Spellcasting: None. At level 3 you choose a calling.
roles.armor_prof: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy Armor, Shields
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed, Versatile, Reach, Great, Ranged Two-Handed

features.name: Preferred Arms
features.description: Choose two weapon groups. While wielding a Preferred Arms weapon, add +1 to attack rolls. At level 10 the bonus becomes +2.

features.name: Draw Breath
features.description: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your Warrior level. 1 use, recharges on a short or long rest.

features.name: Power of Will
features.description: When you miss with a weapon attack, spend one use to reroll the attack; keep the new result. Uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack(2)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 2 extra attacks (three times total).

features.name: Draw Breath(2)
features.description: Draw Breath has 2 uses, regained on a short or long rest. Healing remains 1d10 + Warrior level.

features.name: Push Onward
features.description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you may drop to 1 hit point instead. Once per long rest.

features.name: Power of Will(2)
features.description: Power of Will can also reroll a failed Might, Endurance, or Judgment roll. Same use pool.

features.name: Extra Attack(3)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 3 extra attacks (four times total).

features.name: Sever
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 2d8 damage and the target's speed is halved until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on an Endurance roll vs your Might DC.

data.duration: until start of your next turn

features.name: Push Onward(2)
features.description: When Push Onward triggers, also regain 2d10 + Endurance modifier hit points.

features.name: Power of Will(3)
features.description: When a Power of Will attack reroll hits, add 1d8 damage.

features.name: Extra Attack(4)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 4 extra attacks (five times total).

features.name: Power of Will(4)
features.description: Bonus damage from a Power of Will reroll hit becomes 2d8.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At the start of each of your turns while conscious and below half your hit point maximum, regain hit points equal to 5 + Endurance modifier (minimum 1).

features.name: Sever(2)
features.description: Sever extra damage becomes 3d8. On a failed Endurance roll vs Might DC, speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Reaping Swing
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal an extra 1d8 damage. If the hit drops the target to 0 hit points, regain hit points equal to your Warrior level.

features.name: Harvest
features.description: When you drop a creature to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, as a bonus action move up to half your speed and make one melee weapon attack against a different creature.

features.name: Grim Momentum
features.description: After Harvest, your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn has advantage.

features.name: Scythe Arc
features.description: As an action, make one melee attack against each creature of your choice within 10 feet. Once per short rest.

features.name: Death's Cadence
features.description: On a critical hit with a weapon, regain one spent Draw Breath use, or gain temporary hit points equal to Warrior level if none are spent.

features.name: Reaper's Toll
features.description: Once per long rest when you hit with a melee weapon, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC; on a failure it drops to 0 if it has 100 HP or fewer, otherwise (or on success) it takes 10d10 necrotic.

features.name: Grudge
features.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One mark; replacing ends the old. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

features.name: Retaliate
features.description: When your Grudge target hits you, reaction: one weapon attack against it.

features.name: Blood Debt
features.description: While Grudge is active, the first time each turn the marked creature damages you, it takes necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Spite
features.description: When you hit your Grudge target, you may forgo Grudge bonus damage to impose disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

features.name: Vendetta
features.description: You may maintain two Grudge marks. Retaliate once per marked attacker per round.

features.name: Wrath Unbound
features.description: Once per long rest, when a Grudge target drops you below half HP, your next Attack action against it before the end of your next turn crits on 18-20 and adds 3d8 per hit.

features.name: Heroic Surge
features.description: Bonus action: you and one ally within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + Confidence modifier. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Inspire
features.description: Action: allies within 30 feet (including you) add +1d4 on attack rolls and rolls against fear until the start of your next turn. Once per short rest.

data.duration: until start of your next turn

features.name: Stand Firm
features.description: You and allies within 10 feet have advantage on Endurance and Judgment rolls against shove, fear, or forced movement.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Draw Breath may target an ally within 5 feet instead of you.

features.name: Last Stand
features.description: Reaction when an ally within 30 feet drops to 0 HP: they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

features.name: Legend Born
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and allies within 30 feet add your Confidence modifier (min +1) to damage rolls and cannot be frightened.

roles.name: Witch
roles.description: The Witch relies on Confidence (hex save DC, curse attacks, witch features). Spellcasting: Hybrid (2/3) caster, Confidence.
roles.spellcasting: Hybrid (2/3) caster, Confidence; slots per Shared Frame hybrid table

features.name: Coven Rites
features.description: Learn two Rites. Action: expend a spell slot to enact a known Rite (effects scale with slot rank).

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Cantrips(2)
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Familiar
features.description: Bind a familiar (tiny; HP 10 + 2 x Witch level; AC 12 + Confidence modifier). It acts on your turn. Sense-share as a bonus action. At 0 HP it vanishes and returns after a long rest or a 1-hour ritual plus a 1st-rank slot.

features.name: Seance
features.description: Action: for 10 minutes perceive spirits and ask three yes/no questions of a spirit within 30 feet. Once per short rest. Hostile spirits may resist with a Judgment contest vs your Confidence.

features.name: Coven Rites(2)
features.description: You know 3 Rites.

features.name: Spell Carving
features.description: When you cast a Witch spell of 1st rank or higher, carve it: one target has disadvantage on its first roll against the spell DC, or you gain advantage on the spell attack. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Coven Rites(3)
features.description: Know 4 Rites. Once per short rest enact a Rite as a bonus action.

features.name: Seance(2)
features.description: Seance lasts 30 minutes and allows five questions.

features.name: Spell Carving(2)
features.description: When you carve a spell, once per cast add Confidence modifier as force damage or healing.

features.name: Familiar(2)
features.description: Familiar HP become 20 + 3 x Witch level. It can deliver your touch cantrips within 60 feet of you.

features.name: Coven Rites(4)
features.description: You know 5 Rites.

features.name: Familiar(3)
features.description: Familiar can take the Attack action; attack bonus = proficiency bonus + Confidence.

features.name: Familiar's Bite
features.description: Familiar melee attack: 2d6 + Confidence modifier necrotic or psychic, reach 5 feet.

features.name: Spell Carving(3)
features.description: Spell Carving applies to cantrips.

features.name: Coven Rites(5)
features.description: Know 6 Rites. Once per long rest enact a Rite without a spell slot.

features.name: Grand Coven
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll of each spell they cast, and enemies in the aura have disadvantage on rolls against your spell DCs.

features.name: Seance(3)
features.description: Once per long rest during Seance, compel one short truthful answer (Judgment roll vs Confidence DC to resist).

features.name: Twist of Fate
features.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet rolls a d20, add or subtract 1d4. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Reroll
features.description: Reaction: force a creature within 60 feet to reroll a d20; they use the new result. Once per short rest.

features.name: Thread Reading
features.description: Bonus action: learn a creature within 30 feet's HP band (healthy/bloodied/critical) and whether it has daily auto-success rolls left. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Undo
features.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet takes damage, reduce it by 2d10 + Confidence. Once per short rest.

features.name: Fate's Favor
features.description: Once per long rest, after seeing a d20 within 60 feet but before outcome, replace the result with 10.

features.name: Rewrite Fate
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, choose one creature within 60 feet (or yourself) and reverse or replace one mechanical outcome that occurred since the start of your last turn. Valid targets include: one damage instance, one condition application or removal, one forced move or teleport, one failed check (reroll it and use the new result), or one social or skill outcome (a persuasion/insight/performance-style contest or check result). Death after a completed death sequence cannot be undone. The Guide may block world-scale or multi-creature events beyond character scale. Range 60 feet.

options: undo one forced move or teleport
reroll one failed check (keep new result)
reverse one social or skill outcome

features.name: Lingering Hex
features.description: Bonus action: hex a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. First time each turn it takes damage from you, +1d6 necrotic. Move hex as bonus action if it drops to 0. One hex.

features.name: Double Hex
features.description: Maintain two hexes at once.

features.name: Hex Bloom
features.description: When a hexed creature fails a roll against your spell DC, chosen creatures within 10 feet of it take 1d6 necrotic.

features.name: Jinx
features.description: Reaction when a hexed creature hits: impose -1d6 on the attack roll after seeing it. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Hex Chain
features.description: When a hexed creature dies, reaction: place that hex on a new creature within 30 feet of it.

features.name: Grand Malediction
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, hex every enemy within 30 feet for 1 minute; hex die for this casting is 2d6.

features.name: Bloodletting
features.description: When casting a Witch spell of 1st rank+, lose HP equal to slot rank to add 1d8 necrotic to one target (or restore 1d8 for healing spells).

features.name: Blood Bolt
features.description: Action: spend up to proficiency bonus hit dice; each die deals 1d6 necrotic to a creature within 60 feet (Judgment roll vs Confidence DC halves).

features.name: Crimson Bind
features.description: Action: creature within 30 feet makes Endurance roll vs Confidence DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats roll each turn). You lose 1d6 HP. Once per short rest.

features.name: Boil Blood
features.description: Action: a hexed or Crimson-Bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 necrotic (Endurance vs Confidence DC halves). Once per short rest.

features.name: Blood Pact
features.description: Reaction: ally within 30 feet is hit; you take the damage instead with resistance to it. Once per short rest.

features.name: Sanguine Rite
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, drop to 1 HP and choose up to 6 creatures within 30 feet: each regains 8d8 HP or each enemy takes 8d8 necrotic (Judgment halves). Cannot mix heal and harm.

features.name: Withering Touch
features.description: Melee spell attacks and touch cantrips deal +1d6 necrotic; hit target has disadvantage on Might rolls until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Rot
features.description: Bonus action: infect a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; 1d6 necrotic at start of its turns; Endurance vs Confidence DC ends. Once per short rest.

features.name: Death Knell
features.description: When you drop a creature to 0 with necrotic damage, gain temporary HP equal to Witch level + Confidence.

features.name: Decay Field
features.description: Action: 15-ft-radius field within 60 feet for 1 minute; enemies starting turn there take 2d6 necrotic. Once per short rest.

features.name: Grave Hunger
features.description: While you have temporary HP from Witch features, spell attacks deal +1d8 necrotic.

features.name: Night Eternal
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, 1 minute: 30-ft darkness you and allies see through; enemies take 2d8 necrotic at turn start (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves).

roles.name: Templar
roles.description: The Templar relies on Confidence (oath DC, smites, auras); Might recommended for weapon attacks. Spellcasting: Half caster from level 2, Confidence.
roles.armor_prof: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy Armor, Shields
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed, Versatile, Reach, Great, Ranged Two-Handed
roles.spellcasting: Half caster from level 2, Judgment; slots per Shared Frame half-caster table (top tier 6th)

features.name: Sense of the Divine
features.description: Action or bonus action: know the location of celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet unless protected from divination. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Grace
features.description: Bonus action: touch a creature to restore hit points equal to 1d8 + Judgment modifier. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Spellcraft(2)
features.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Judgment.

features.name: Divine Arms
features.description: You are proficient with martial weapons and heavy armor. As a bonus action for 1 minute, your weapon counts as magical and deals +1d4 radiant. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Heavenly Strike
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-rank slot, +1d8 per slot rank above 1st, +1d8 if the target is undead or fiend.

features.name: Extra Attack(2)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 2 extra attacks (three times total).

features.name: Angelic Decree
features.description: Action: each enemy of your choice within 30 feet makes a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC or is frightened until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.

data.duration: until end of your next turn

features.name: Heavenly Presence
features.description: Aura 10 feet: allies add +1 to rolls against fear and charm. You shed dim light 10 feet.

scaling.change: Heavenly Presence(2): aura 30 feet; +1 to allies' AC
Heavenly Presence(3): aura 30 feet; allies in aura regain 1d4 HP at start of your turn

features.name: Extra Attack(3)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 3 extra attacks (four times total).

features.name: Greater Heavenly Strike
features.description: Heavenly Strike base becomes 3d8, and you may trigger it once per turn without expending a slot dealing 2d8 radiant (still scales with slots if you expend one).

features.name: Heavenly Presence(2)
features.description: Aura becomes 30 feet. Allies in the aura gain +1 AC.

features.name: Cleansing Grace
features.description: When you use Grace, you may also end one poison, disease, or mild curse on the target.

features.name: Extra Attack(4)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 4 extra attacks (five times total).

features.name: Heavenly Presence(3)
features.description: Allies in your 30-foot aura regain 1d4 hit points at the start of your turn while the aura is active (always on while conscious).

features.name: Grand Order
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your Heavenly Strike free trigger deals 4d8 radiant, and your aura grants allies advantage on Judgment and Endurance rolls.

features.name: Willow's Shelter
features.description: When you heal with Grace or a Templar spell, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your Judgment modifier (min 1).

features.name: Mending Bough
features.description: Action: restore 2d8 + Judgment HP to each creature of your choice within 15 feet. Once per short rest.

features.name: Rooted Guard
features.description: While you haven't moved since the start of your turn, allies within 10 feet gain +1 AC and you have advantage on rolls against being moved.

features.name: Willow Ward
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is hit, grant them resistance to that damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Sanctuary Grove
features.description: Action: 20-ft-radius sanctuary for 1 minute. Allies ending turn there regain 1d8 HP; enemies treat the area as difficult terrain. Once per long rest.

features.name: Ancient Willow
features.description: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to your Templar level + Judgment.

features.name: Hope Renewed
features.description: When you roll initiative, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus + Judgment modifier.

features.name: Rally Strength
features.description: Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet adds 1d6 to their next attack roll or roll against a condition before the start of your next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Steadfast
features.description: You have advantage on rolls against fear and charm. Allies within 10 feet may use your Judgment modifier in place of theirs once per short rest when failing such a roll (reaction).

features.name: Borrowed Time
features.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet fails a death roll, treat it as a success. Once per short rest.

features.name: Dawn's Promise
features.description: When you restore HP to a creature at 0 HP, it may stand (costs no movement) and make one weapon attack as a reaction.

features.name: Undying Morrow
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute dying allies within 30 feet are stable at the start of their turns and regain 1 HP if still at 0 when they stabilize this way.

features.name: Death's Embrace
features.description: Heavenly Strike may deal necrotic instead of radiant. Against undead, add +1d8.

features.name: Gravefire
features.description: Bonus action: your weapon sheds 1d6 necrotic for 1 minute; when you drop a creature to 0, one enemy within 10 feet takes 1d6 necrotic. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Fallen Strength
features.description: While you are below half HP, add your Judgment modifier to melee damage (min +1).

features.name: Tower Ward
features.description: Action: gain temporary HP equal to 2d10 + Templar level and resistance to necrotic and radiant for 1 minute. Once per short rest.

features.name: Last Rites
features.description: When you reduce an undead or fiend to 0 HP, you may force a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC; on a failure it is destroyed and cannot reform by common means for 24 hours.

features.name: Lord of the Tower
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute undead and fiends within 30 feet have disadvantage on attacks against you, and your Heavenly Strike free trigger deals 3d8 necrotic or radiant.

features.name: Vengeful Shade
features.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your weapon attacks against it deal +1d6 necrotic, and it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you while within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Mark of Wrath
features.description: When your mark deals damage to an ally, you may use your reaction to move up to your speed toward it and make one melee attack.

features.name: Shadow Smite
features.description: Heavenly Strike using necrotic adds +1d8 and the target makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Punisher
features.description: Your mark lasts 10 minutes and persists if you are incapacitated (not dead). You may have two marks.

features.name: Oath of Night
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit your mark, deal extra 3d8 necrotic and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Dark Order
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you know the direction to your mark regardless of distance on the same plane, your speed increases by 20 feet toward it, and critical hits against it deal +4d8 necrotic.

roles.name: Mage
roles.description: The Mage relies on Intellect (spell attack, spell save DC, arcane features). Spellcasting: Full caster, Intellect.
roles.spellcasting: Full caster, Intellect; slots per Shared Frame full-caster table

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Intellect.

features.name: Cantrips(3)
features.description: You know 3 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Spellbook
features.description: You keep a spellbook. You prepare Intellect modifier + Mage level spells from it each long rest (minimum 1). Copying a spell of 1st rank+ costs time and gold per rank (Guide table).

features.name: Mana Well
features.description: Once per short rest as a bonus action, recover expended spell slots whose combined ranks are at most half your Mage level (rounded up), none higher than 5th rank. At Mana Well(2)/(3) the cap and frequency improve.

scaling.change: Mana Well(2): combined ranks up to Mage level; one slot may be 6th
Mana Well(3): twice per short rest; or once recover any single slot of 7th or lower

features.name: Prepared Study
features.description: When you finish a short rest, you may replace one prepared spell with another from your book.

features.name: Mana Well(2)
features.description: Mana Well recovers combined ranks up to your Mage level; one recovered slot may be 6th rank.

features.name: Cantrips(4)
features.description: You know 4 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Spell Weaving
features.description: When you cast a cantrip as an action, you may cast a different Mage cantrip as a bonus action the same turn. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Mana Well(3)
features.description: Mana Well: 2 uses per short rest, or spend both uses at once to recover one slot of 7th rank or lower.

features.name: Grand Grimoire
features.description: Your spellbook can hold ritual versions of any Mage spell you know; rituals take 10 minutes and do not expend slots. You prepare two extra spells.

features.name: Archmage
features.description: Once per long rest when you cast a Mage spell of 1st rank+, treat it as if cast using a slot one rank higher (max 9th). You also regain one expended 1st- or 2nd-rank slot at the start of each of your turns in combat while you have none of those ranks left (once per turn).

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or force). Your cantrips and Mage spells that deal that damage type add +1d4. Change attunement on a long rest.

features.name: Sculpt Blast
features.description: When you cast an area Mage spell, choose up to Intellect modifier creatures (min 1) in the area; they automatically succeed on their rolls and take no damage.

features.name: Empowered Element
features.description: Once per turn when you roll damage for your attuned element, reroll any 1s on those dice.

features.name: Elemental Pierce
features.description: Attuned-element spells ignore resistance (not immunity).

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: When you cast a Mage spell of 5th rank or lower that deals damage, maximum damage on the dice. You take 2d12 force per spell rank afterward. Once per long rest (or risk again: each extra use until long rest adds +1d12 to the backlash).

features.name: Avatar of the Element
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you gain immunity to your attuned element, your cantrips of that type deal +2d8, and enemies that hit you in melee take 2d8 of that type.

features.name: Conjure Tool
features.description: Bonus action: create a simple nonmagical object (up to 5 lb) for 1 hour or until dismissed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Spectral Servant
features.description: Action: summon an unseen servant (AC 12, HP = 5 x Mage level, speed 30) for 1 hour. It can do simple labor and take the Help action. Once per short rest.

features.name: Swift Summons
features.description: Conjuration spells of 1st-3rd rank with casting time action may be cast as a bonus action once per short rest.

features.name: Bound Ally
features.description: When you summon a creature with a Mage spell, add your proficiency bonus to its AC and attack rolls for the duration.

features.name: Twin Conjuring
features.description: Once per long rest when you cast a conjuration that summons one creature, summon two instead (shared duration; both vanish when the spell ends).

features.name: Gatekeeper
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, open a gate for 1 minute to a known location on the same plane within 100 miles, or summon a single powerful allied spirit (Guide profile) for 1 minute that obeys your commands.

features.name: Dream Step
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet to a space you can see. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

features.name: Dream Slot
features.description: After a long rest, choose one prepared Mage spell of 1st or 2nd rank; you may cast it once without a slot before your next long rest.

features.name: Mirrored Casting
features.description: When you cast a single-target Mage spell of 1st-4th rank, once per short rest also affect a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

features.name: Lucid Veil
features.description: Action: you and allies within 10 feet become invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or 10 minutes pass. Once per short rest.

features.name: Dream Echo
features.description: Reaction: when you are hit, teleport up to 30 feet and the attacker makes an Intellect roll vs your Intellect DC or misses. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Waking Dream
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute create three illusory duplicates (as a mirror image effect with 3 images) and your Dream Step has unlimited uses during that minute.

features.name: Rune Etching
features.description: During a long rest, etch a rune on a weapon or armor you touch. Weapon: +1d4 damage of a chosen type. Armor: +1 AC. One rune active; lasts until next long rest.

features.name: Battle Scribe
features.description: Bonus action: activate a prepared combat glyph (blast 2d6 in 10 ft, or shield +2 AC until start of next turn). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Twin Runes
features.description: You may maintain two etched runes. Battle Scribe glyphs deal 3d6.

features.name: Runic Ward
features.description: Reaction: when hit, expend a glyph to gain resistance to that damage and push the attacker 10 feet (Might roll vs Intellect DC negates push). Once per short rest free; or spend a Battle Scribe use.

features.name: Living Inscription
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your weapon rune damage becomes +2d8, your AC rune becomes +3, and Battle Scribe does not expend uses.

roles.name: Summoner
roles.description: The Summoner relies on Confidence (binding, summon command, spell DC). Spellcasting: Half caster, rounded up (slots from level 1), Confidence.
roles.spellcasting: Half caster, rounded up (slots from level 1), Intellect; slots per Shared Frame half-caster (rounded up) table (top tier 6th)

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Intellect.

features.name: Cantrips(2)
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Summoning Slots
features.description: You have summoning slots separate from spell slots. At level 1: two 1st-rank summoning slots. They fuel Legion summons. Regain on long rest. Ranks improve with Summoning Slots(n).

scaling.change: Summoning Slots(4): add one 4th-rank and one 5th-rank

features.name: Legion
features.description: As an action, expend a summoning slot to call a summon that takes its own turns in combat (initiative = yours - 1, or rolled). You may have 2 summons active from level 1. A summon's profile uses the slot rank (Guide table). If you drop to 0 HP, summons vanish at end of your next turn unless refreshed.

scaling.change: Legion(3): summons add your proficiency bonus to attack rolls

features.name: Forced Command
features.description: Bonus action: choose one of your summons; it immediately takes one action (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Help, or a listed summon action). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

scaling.change: Forced Command(2): the summon also moves up to its speed; 2 uses refresh on short rest as well as the long-rest pool once each short rest (max proficiency bonus still)

features.name: Summoning Slots(2)
features.description: Gain two 2nd-rank summoning slots (long rest).

features.name: Empowered Summons
features.description: Your summons add your Intellect modifier (min +1) to damage rolls.

scaling.change: Empowered Summons(2): also +proficiency bonus to damage once per summon turn

features.name: Shared Senses
features.description: Bonus action: see and hear through one summon within 1 mile for 1 minute. You are blind/deaf to your own senses while doing so.

features.name: Legion(2)
features.description: You may have 3 summons active.

features.name: Summoning Slots(3)
features.description: Gain two 3rd-rank summoning slots.

features.name: Forced Command(2)
features.description: Forced Command also lets the summon move up to its speed. Once per short rest you regain one Forced Command use.

features.name: Summoning Slots(4)
features.description: Gain one 4th-rank and one 5th-rank summoning slot.

features.name: Empowered Summons(2)
features.description: Once on each summon's turn, add your proficiency bonus to one damage roll.

features.name: Legion(3)
features.description: Summons add your proficiency bonus to their attack rolls.

features.name: Legion(4)
features.description: You may have 4 summons active.

features.name: Allegiance
features.description: Action: one creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs your Intellect DC. On a failure it is controlled by you (ally to you) for 1 minute. It repeats the Judgment roll at the end of each of its turns; on a success the effect ends. Once per long rest. Does not work on creatures with legendary resistance-style daily auto-successes unless the Guide allows. Allegiance targets are not summons: they cannot receive Forced Command, do not count against your Legion cap, and only follow simple commands (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or drop an item).

features.name: Raise Dead
features.description: When you use Legion with a summoning slot, you may raise a skeleton or zombie profile instead of a standard summon. Undead summons have +1 AC.

features.name: Grave Bond
features.description: When an undead summon within 30 feet hits, you may use your reaction to deal 1d6 necrotic to the target or regain 1d6 HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Bone Armor
features.description: Bonus action: sacrifice an undead summon within 30 feet; you gain temporary HP equal to twice its remaining HP (max 40). Once per short rest.

features.name: Bound Soul
features.description: One undead summon can remain active for 24 hours without counting against your Legion cap overnight (still counts in combat encounters). Refresh on long rest.

features.name: Death's Toll
features.description: When an undead summon drops to 0, enemies within 10 feet of it take 2d8 necrotic (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves).

features.name: Lord of the Bound
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute undead summons have advantage on attacks and when they hit the target makes an Endurance roll vs Intellect DC or is frightened until end of its next turn.

features.name: Call the Hollow
features.description: Legion can call Hollow spirits (insubstantial; resistance to nonmagical weapons; vulnerable to radiant). Hollows ignore difficult terrain.

features.name: Hollow Pact
features.description: When a Hollow hits, you may deal 1d6 psychic instead of its normal bonus and the target has disadvantage on its next Judgment roll before your next turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Swarm Call
features.description: Action: expend a 2nd-rank or higher summoning slot to call three Tiny Hollow swarmlets that share one turn and one HP pool (use swarm profile). Once per short rest.

features.name: Hollow Gate
features.description: Bonus action: teleport yourself or one Hollow up to 30 feet to a space either of you can see. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Direct the Horde
features.description: Forced Command can target two Hollows at once (one use).

features.name: Hollow Sovereign
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute all Hollows within 60 feet gain +2 to AC and attacks, and enemies that start their turn within 5 feet of two or more Hollows take 2d8 psychic.

features.name: Assemble Construct
features.description: Legion can call constructs (armor +1 AC, immunity to poison and psychic). Constructs can be repaired with Scrap Field Repair.

features.name: Scrap Field Repair
features.description: Bonus action: one construct within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Modular Parts
features.description: During a short rest, grant one construct a module: reach +5 ft, speed +10 ft, or +1d6 damage. Lasts until next long rest.

features.name: Overclock
features.description: Bonus action: one construct gains an extra action on its next turn, then takes 2d8 force backlash. Once per short rest.

features.name: Living Machine
features.description: Constructs add your proficiency bonus to Endurance rolls and automatically succeed on rolls against fear.

features.name: Forge Titan
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, expend a 5th-rank summoning slot (or your highest) to call a Huge construct for 1 minute (Guide titan profile) that does not count against Legion cap.

roles.name: Assassin
roles.description: The Assassin relies on Precision (finesse/ranged attacks, poison and gadget DCs, stealth features). Spellcasting: None.
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed

features.name: Hidden Blade
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon attack while you have advantage, or while an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you do not have disadvantage, deal extra 1d6 Precision damage. Scales Sneak d6 every 2.

features.name: Shadowstep
features.description: Bonus action while in dim light or darkness: Dash, Disengage, or Hide. At Shadowstep(2) also teleport 15 feet in dim light/darkness.

features.name: Quick Hands
features.description: Advantage on Precision checks to pick locks, steal, or plant objects. You can use thieves' tools as a bonus action.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Hidden Blade(2)
features.description: Hidden Blade dice become 3d6 (and continue Sneak d6 every 2 thereafter).

features.name: Mark for Death
features.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Your next Hidden Blade hit against it before the mark ends deals +2d6 and you know its direction while marked. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Vanish
features.description: Reaction when you take damage: become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Once per short rest.

features.name: Hidden Blade(3)
features.description: Hidden Blade dice become 7d6 (continues scaling).

features.name: Shadowstep(2)
features.description: While in dim light or darkness, Shadowstep may teleport you up to 15 feet to another dim/dark space you can see.

features.name: Death Sentence
features.description: Once per long rest when you hit a Mark for Death target with Hidden Blade, the attack is a critical hit and the mark's bonus becomes +4d6.

features.name: Phantom
features.description: You can Hide as a bonus action even in plain sight against creatures more than 10 feet away (Speed contest vs their Judgment). While invisible from Vanish, your next weapon attack has advantage and automatically qualifies for Hidden Blade.

features.name: Toxin Craft
features.description: During a long rest, prepare doses of toxin equal to proficiency bonus. Apply as a bonus action to a weapon for 1 minute. First hit deals 1d6 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.

features.name: Venom Strike
features.description: Hidden Blade may deal poison damage. When it does, target has disadvantage on Endurance rolls until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Virulent Dose
features.description: Toxin damage becomes 2d6 and poisoned lasts 1 minute (repeats Endurance at end of turns).

features.name: Lingering Toxin
features.description: A poisoned creature takes 1d6 poison at the start of each of its turns while poisoned.

features.name: Plague Blade
features.description: Once per short rest when toxin hits, creatures within 5 feet of the target make Endurance vs Precision DC or also become poisoned for 1 minute.

features.name: Deathbloom
features.description: Once per long rest, a toxin hit deals 6d6 poison (Endurance halves) and on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Borrowed Face
features.description: Action: alter your appearance (clothing, face, height within 1 foot) for 1 hour. Inspection contests Judgment vs your Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Ghost Step
features.description: When you Hide, you may move 10 feet without revealing yourself. Shadowstep distance for teleport (when gained) increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Untraceable
features.description: Advantage on rolls to avoid tracking, and magic that would locate you has disadvantage or requires a Judgment contest vs your Precision.

features.name: Phase Through
features.description: Bonus action: move through occupied spaces and objects as difficult terrain this turn; end in an unoccupied space. If inside an object at end of turn, take 2d10 force and eject. Once per short rest.

features.name: Mirror Self
features.description: Action: create a perfect illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute. It mimics your movements; attacks against you have 50% chance to hit the double instead. Once per short rest.

features.name: Specter
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you are ethereal (move through creatures/objects; attack into material with disadvantage unless using magical weapons; resistance to nonmagical damage).

features.name: Spellcraft(2)
features.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Intellect.

features.name: Spellblade
features.description: You may use Precision for spell attacks with Assassin spells. When you use Extra Attack, replace one attack with a cantrip that requires an attack roll.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: Reaction: when targeted by an attack you can see, impose disadvantage on the attack, or redirect it to a creature within 5 feet of you (other than attacker) if the redirected target is willing or fails a Precision contest vs you. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Ambush
features.description: When you cast an Assassin spell of 1st rank+ while hidden, the target has disadvantage on rolls against its DC, or you have advantage on the spell attack.

features.name: Stolen Spell
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell of 3rd rank or lower, reaction: make an Intellect contest vs their casting stat; on a success you negate it and may cast that spell once before a long rest using your slots. Once per long rest.

features.name: Hex Blade
features.description: Bonus action: arcane mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute; your weapon and spell attacks against it deal +1d6 force. Scales Brand d6 every 5 from 15.

features.name: Grand Deceiver
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you have advantage on Confidence and Precision rolls, Misdirection does not expend uses, and Arcane Ambush applies even when not hidden.

roles.name: Priest
roles.description: The Priest relies on Judgment (spell DC, Channel Divinity, healing). Spellcasting: Full caster, Judgment.
roles.spellcasting: Full caster, Judgment; slots per Shared Frame full-caster table

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Judgment.

features.name: Cantrips(2)
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Twin Veil
features.description: You cast Celestial and Shade magic. After each long rest, choose Veil of Light or Veil of Shade: Light grants +1d4 to healing you restore; Shade grants +1d4 necrotic or psychic to one damage roll of each Priest spell you cast. Twin Veil(2) lets you switch as a bonus action once per short rest.

features.name: Litany
features.description: Bonus action: chant for 1 minute (concentration not required). Allies within 30 feet add +1 to attack rolls (Light) or enemies within 30 feet subtract 1 from attack rolls against your allies (Shade). Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

scaling.change: Litany(2): bonus/penalty becomes +2/-2; duration without ending if you cast Priest spells

features.name: Eclipse Touch
features.description: Melee spell attack or touch: 2d8 radiant (Light) or necrotic (Shade); Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or blinded until end of its next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Litany(2)
features.description: Litany bonus or penalty becomes 2. Casting Priest spells does not end Litany.

features.name: Dusk Mantle
features.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet is hit, grant resistance to that damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Twin Veil(2)
features.description: Bonus action once per short rest: switch Veil of Light/Shade. Both Veil bonuses become +1d6.

features.name: Revelation
features.description: Action: for 10 minutes you see invisible creatures and into the ethereal within 60 feet, and know if a creature within 30 feet is lying (Judgment contest). Once per long rest.

features.name: Herald of Twilight
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you embody both Veils: healing and spell damage bonuses both apply at +2d6, and Litany applies both the ally attack bonus and enemy attack penalty.

features.name: Radiant Mending
features.description: When you restore HP with a Priest spell or Grace-like feature, add your Judgment modifier (min +1). Once per turn also grant 1d6 temporary HP.

features.name: Aegis
features.description: Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet gains +2 AC for 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Shared Light
features.description: When you cast a single-target Priest healing spell, a second creature within 15 feet of the target regains HP equal to half the amount (rounded up).

features.name: Halo Ward
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet fails an Endurance or Judgment roll, add 1d8 to the result. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Second Dawn
features.description: Once per long rest when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 HP, they instead drop to 1 HP and regain 4d8 + Judgment HP.

features.name: Sun Idol
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns and enemies that hit them take 1d8 radiant.

features.name: Binding Sigil
features.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has disadvantage on the first attack each turn against creatures other than you.

features.name: Chains of Faith
features.description: Action: target within 30 feet makes a Might roll vs Judgment DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.

features.name: Seal Magic
features.description: Reaction: when a marked creature casts a spell, force a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC; on a failure the spell is wasted. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Warded Circle
features.description: Action: 15-ft-radius circle for 1 minute. Chosen creatures cannot leave or enter without succeeding on a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC. Once per short rest.

features.name: Exile
features.description: Action: marked creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is banished for 1 minute (repeats each turn; ends if you lose concentration-equivalent: if you drop to 0 or willingly end). Once per long rest.

features.name: Final Seal
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, bind a creature within 30 feet: it is restrained and silenced for 1 minute; it may make one Judgment roll at the end of each turn at disadvantage to end the seal.

features.name: Shade Whisper
features.description: Bonus action: whisper to a creature within 60 feet that can hear you; it makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Fear Mark
features.description: When a creature fails a roll against your fear effects, mark it for 1 minute; your Shade spells deal +1d6 psychic to it.

features.name: Hollow Voice
features.description: You may speak telepathically to any creature within 60 feet. Once per short rest, plant a one-sentence suggestion; Judgment vs Judgment DC to resist for 1 hour (harmful acts auto-fail the suggestion).

features.name: Shadow Communion
features.description: Action: ask three questions of lingering shades within 30 feet (truthful short answers). Once per short rest.

features.name: Night Shroud
features.description: Bonus action: you and one ally within 30 feet become lightly obscured and ignore disadvantage from darkness for 10 minutes. Once per short rest.

features.name: Voice of the Void
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, each enemy within 30 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or is frightened for 1 minute and takes 4d8 psychic; repeats each turn. On success, half damage and no fear.

roles.name: Berserker
roles.description: The Berserker relies on Might (Endurance secondary). Spellcasting: None.
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed, Versatile, Reach, Great

features.name: Fury
features.description: Bonus action: enter Fury for 1 minute. While furious: advantage on Might checks and Might attack rolls, +2 melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. Ends early if you end your turn without attacking or taking damage since your last turn. Uses = 2; regain one on short rest, all on long rest. Fury(2)/(3) add uses and damage.

scaling.change: Fury(2): 3 uses; +3 damage; resist all physical including magical
Fury(3): 4 uses; +4 damage; once per Fury ignore incapacitation until end of your next turn

features.name: Unarmored Toughness
features.description: While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + Precision + Endurance. You may use a shield.

features.name: Reckless Swing
features.description: On your turn, gain advantage on melee weapon attacks until your next turn; attacks against you have advantage until then.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Fury(2)
features.description: Fury uses become 3. Melee damage bonus +3. Resistance includes magical bludgeoning/piercing/slashing.

features.name: Unbroken
features.description: While furious, if you would drop to 0 HP, make an Endurance roll DC 10 + damage taken beyond your HP; on success drop to 1 HP instead. DC increases by 5 each success until long rest; resets on long rest.

features.name: Bloodlust
features.description: While furious, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you may move up to half speed and make one melee attack (once per turn).

features.name: Fury(3)
features.description: Fury uses become 4; damage bonus +4. Once per Fury, when you would be incapacitated, delay it until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Warbringer
features.description: Might and Endurance scores increase by 4 (respecting caps). While furious, speed +10 feet and Reckless Swing no longer grants advantage on attacks against you.

features.name: Thorned Fury
features.description: While furious, once per turn when you hit with melee, deal +1d6 and the target bleeds: 1d4 at the start of each of its turns until it regains HP or 1 minute passes.

features.name: Bleeding Edge
features.description: Bleed dice become 1d6. Critical hits apply bleed automatically without using the once-per-turn limit.

features.name: Sanguine Hunger
features.description: When a bleeding creature within 30 feet takes bleed damage, you regain HP equal to half the bleed damage (rounded up).

features.name: Barbed Hide
features.description: While furious, creatures that hit you with melee take 1d6 piercing. Scales Ongoing d6 every 5 from 13.

features.name: Blood Feast
features.description: Bonus action while furious: end all bleeds you applied within 60 feet; deal remaining bleed dice as necrotic and regain that much HP. Once per short rest.

features.name: Thornking
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action while furious, for 1 minute your once-per-turn thorn damage becomes +2d8, bleed is 2d6, and Barbed Hide is 2d6.

features.name: Storm Fury
features.description: While furious, your melee deals +1d4 lightning. Once per Fury as a bonus action, bolt a creature within 30 feet for 1d8 lightning (Speed roll vs Might DC halves).

features.name: Tempest Step
features.description: While furious, ignore difficult terrain; when you Dash, deal 1d6 lightning to one creature you pass within 5 feet of.

features.name: Elemental Hide
features.description: While furious, resistance to lightning and thunder; advantage on rolls against being moved by wind or water.

features.name: Shattering Roar
features.description: Action while furious: enemies within 15 feet make an Endurance roll vs Might DC or take 3d8 thunder and are deafened 1 minute. Once per short rest.

features.name: Living Storm
features.description: While furious, at the start of your turn enemies within 5 feet take 1d6 lightning.

features.name: Wrath of the Reeds
features.description: Once per long rest as an action while furious, for 1 minute your melee lightning becomes +2d6, bolt becomes 3d8, and Living Storm is 2d6.

features.name: Bone Grip
features.description: While furious, you may dual-wield two-handed melee weapons. When you take the Attack action with one of them, you may make one attack with the other as a bonus action (same dual-wield rhythm as the Assassin: one off-hand attack on the bonus action). The off-hand attack uses the weapon's normal damage die and your Might modifier.

features.name: Giant's Growth
features.description: Bonus action while furious: grow one size for 1 minute (reach +5 ft, advantage on Might checks, weapons deal +1d4). Once per Fury.

features.name: Crushing Blow
features.description: Once per turn while furious and grown or dual-wielding great weapons, a melee hit deals +1d8 and the target makes a Might roll vs your Might DC or is knocked prone.

features.name: Bone Plating
features.description: While furious, gain temporary HP equal to your Berserker level when you enter Fury, and +1 AC.

features.name: Titan Stride
features.description: Giant's Growth: +1d8 weapon damage, reach +5 ft stacks with size, and you may grow even if not furious once per long rest for 1 minute.

features.name: Colossus
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute grow two sizes (Huge if you started Medium), keep Bone Grip dual-wield (one off-hand great-weapon attack as a bonus action), and Crushing Blow becomes +2d8.

roles.name: Seer
roles.description: The Seer relies on Judgment (spell DC, Wild Shape, nature features). Spellcasting: Full caster, Judgment.
roles.spellcasting: Full caster, Judgment; slots per Shared Frame full-caster table

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Judgment.

features.name: Cantrips(2)
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Wild Tongue
features.description: You can speak with beasts and plants. Judgment checks to influence them have advantage. Wild Tongue(2) extends to elementals of nature.

features.name: Verdant Grasp
features.description: Bonus action: vines restrain a creature within 30 feet (Might vs Judgment DC to avoid; repeats each turn) for 1 minute. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

scaling.change: Verdant Grasp(2): also deals 1d6 piercing at start of target turn; 2 targets if you expend two uses

features.name: Nature's Sight
features.description: Action: for 10 minutes sense the health of land within 1 mile and know presence of aberrations, undead, and unnatural blight. Once per short rest.

features.name: Verdant Grasp(2)
features.description: Restrained targets take 1d6 piercing at the start of their turns. You may spend two uses to target two creatures.

features.name: Cantrips(3)
features.description: You know 3 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Worldroot
features.description: Action: teleport up to 60 feet to a space with plant life or soft earth you have seen. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Thornheart
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet hits you with melee, it takes 1d8 piercing. You may use Judgment instead of Precision for opportunity attack rolls with melee spells or weapons you are proficient with.

features.name: Wild Tongue(2)
features.description: Wild Tongue includes nature elementals; you may cast Seer spells with verbal components through plants within 30 feet.

features.name: Grove Ascendant
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute a 30-ft radius becomes difficult terrain for enemies, allies regain 1d6 HP at the start of their turns, and Verdant Grasp does not expend uses.

features.name: Voice of the Wild
features.description: You may maintain concentration-equivalent on two Seer spells at once (if either would break, choose which ends). Once per long rest, cast a Seer spell of 5th rank or lower without a slot.

features.name: Animal Ally
features.description: You gain a beast companion (CR 1/4 or lower). It acts on your turn; you command it as a bonus action. If it dies, ritual 8 hours to bond another.

features.name: Flock Call
features.description: Action: summon a swarm of tiny beasts for 1 minute (Guide swarm profile). Once per short rest.

features.name: Beast Sight
features.description: Share senses with your companion or a beast within 100 feet for 10 minutes as an action. Once per short rest free; or expend a spell slot of 1st+.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: You and your companion have advantage on attacks against a creature if the other is within 5 feet of it and not incapacitated.

features.name: Many Wings
features.description: You may have two companions (shared bonus-action command: both take the commanded action), or one companion and a flock simultaneously.

features.name: Lord of the Wild
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute all beasts of your choice within 60 feet are friendly and may each make one attack against a target you choose when summoned to act.

features.name: Moonlit Spells
features.description: When you cast a Seer spell at night or in moonlight, add +1d4 to one damage or healing roll. In darkness you see 30 feet without penalty.

features.name: Lunar Ward
features.description: Reaction: when hit, gain +1d8 temporary HP that apply to that hit first. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Starfall
features.description: Action: creatures in a 10-ft radius within 60 feet take 3d6 radiant (Speed vs Judgment DC halves). Once per short rest.

features.name: Phases of the Moon
features.description: After a long rest, choose Full (healing spells +1d8), Crescent (spell save DC +1), or New (first spell each combat does not provoke and has advantage on spell attack).

features.name: Eclipse
features.description: Action: 20-ft radius within 60 feet becomes magical darkness for 1 minute that you and allies can see through. Enemies starting turn there take 2d6 cold. Once per long rest.

features.name: Celestial Seer
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute gain all three moon phases at once and Starfall recharges on each of your turns (still an action).

features.name: Beast Shape
features.description: Action: assume a beast form (CR 1 or lower) for 1 hour. Retain Judgment and HP; use beast stats otherwise. Uses = 2 per short rest.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: Advantage on initiative. If surprised, you may still act if you enter Beast Shape first on your turn.

features.name: Primal Strikes
features.description: Beast form attacks count as magical. Once per turn +1d6 damage in beast or hybrid form.

features.name: Hybrid Form
features.description: Bonus action: hybrid form 10 minutes — keep hands/speech, natural weapons 1d8, AC 13 + Precision, speed +10. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Pack Leader
features.description: Allies within 10 feet gain +1 to attack rolls while you are in beast or hybrid form. Your beast forms may be CR 3.

features.name: Alpha
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute hybrid form has Extra Attack (two natural attacks), Primal Strikes +2d6, and Pack Leader aura 30 feet.

roles.name: Pugilist
roles.description: The Pugilist relies on Precision (Endurance secondary; Might optional for grapple builds). Spellcasting: None.

features.name: Iron Fists
features.description: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Precision bludgeoning (or Might if you choose at level 1). They count as magical from level 6. Iron Fists(2) improves the die.

features.name: Footwork
features.description: Unarmored AC = 10 + Precision + Speed. Speed +10 feet while unarmored and not using a shield.

features.name: Flurry
features.description: After the Attack action with unarmed or pugilist weapons, bonus action: two unarmed strikes. Uses = proficiency bonus per short rest (Grit-like pool called Drive: spend 1 Drive).

scaling.change: Flurry(2): three unarmed strikes; or two and shove

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Counterpunch
features.description: Reaction: when missed by a melee attack within reach, make one unarmed strike against the attacker. Uses = Speed modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Iron Fists(2)
features.description: Unarmed die becomes 1d10.

features.name: Unshakable
features.description: Advantage on rolls against being frightened, restrained by mundane bonds, or moved against your will.

features.name: Combo Chain
features.description: When you hit the same creature with three unarmed strikes in one turn, it makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn. Once per turn.

features.name: Flurry(2)
features.description: Flurry: three unarmed strikes, or two strikes and a shove (Might or Precision contest).

features.name: Stone Body
features.description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Knockout Blow
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit with unarmed, force an Endurance roll vs Precision DC; on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn (or unconscious if HP are below 50).

features.name: Undisputed
features.description: Unarmed die 2d8. When you roll initiative, regain all Drive (Flurry uses). Combo Chain stuns on two hits against the same target in a turn.

features.name: Null Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with unarmed, the target has disadvantage on rolls to maintain ongoing spells until the start of your next turn, and you deal +1d4 force.

features.name: Spell Ward
features.description: Reaction: when targeted by a spell, add +1d6 to AC or to a roll against its DC. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Redirect
features.description: When you succeed on a roll against a single-target spell of 3rd rank or lower, you may use your reaction to redirect it to another creature within 30 feet of you (original caster's roll or your Precision for attack).

features.name: Silencing Blow
features.description: When you hit with Null Strike, the target cannot cast spells with verbal components until the end of its next turn (Endurance vs Precision DC).

features.name: Mana Rend
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit a creature concentrating on a spell (or maintaining an ongoing spell effect), it takes +3d8 force and the roll to keep the spell has disadvantage.

features.name: Spellbreaker
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your unarmed strikes end ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on the target on a hit (Judgment vs Precision DC for 6th+).

features.name: Weak Point
features.description: Bonus action: analyze a creature within 30 feet; until the end of your next turn your unarmed attacks against it ignore 2 AC from armor/shield and deal +1d4.

features.name: Armor Crack
features.description: When you hit the same creature twice in a turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn (stacks to -3).

features.name: Precise Blow
features.description: Once per turn add Precision modifier again as bonus damage against a Weak Point target (min +1).

features.name: Shatter Guard
features.description: Action: one melee unarmed attack with advantage; on hit destroy a nonmagical shield or reduce magical AC bonus by 1 for 1 minute. Once per short rest.

features.name: Vital Strike
features.description: When you crit with unarmed, deal +3d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Breaking Point
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Weak Point is permanent on one target, Armor Crack stacks to -5, and Precise Blow applies to every hit against it.

features.name: Flowing Element
features.description: Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or water/force). Unarmed strikes deal +1d4 of that type. Change on long rest.

features.name: Current Step
features.description: When you Flurry, you may move 10 feet before or between strikes without provoking.

features.name: Redirect Flow
features.description: Reaction: when hit by a melee attack, Speed contest vs attacker's Might or Precision; on success take half damage and the attacker takes the other half as your element type.

features.name: Elemental Palm
features.description: Action: 15-ft cone of your element, 4d6 damage (Speed vs Precision DC halves). Once per short rest.

features.name: Still Water
features.description: At the start of your turn, if you moved 0 feet since the start of your last turn, regain 1 Drive and gain +1 AC until you move.

features.name: Perfect Flow
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Flurry does not cost Drive, Flowing Element becomes +2d6, and Redirect Flow auto-succeeds once per turn.

roles.name: Ranger
roles.description: The Ranger relies on Precision (attacks, class features); Judgment secondary for tracking and spell DC. Spellcasting: Half caster from level 2, Judgment.
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed, Versatile, Reach, Great, Ranged Two-Handed
roles.spellcasting: Half caster from level 2, Judgment; slots per Shared Frame half-caster table (top tier 6th)

features.name: Bounty
features.description: Bonus action: designate a creature within 60 feet as your Bounty for 1 hour (or until it drops to 0). Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One bounty. Bounty(2) improves.

scaling.change: Bounty(2): +proficiency to track; damage +1d6 more at 8 from scaling

features.name: Tracker
features.description: Advantage on Judgment and Precision checks to track, hunt, or recall lore about beasts and humanoids you have studied for 1 minute.

features.name: Spellcraft(2)
features.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Judgment.

features.name: Hunter's Discipline
features.description: Choose a discipline: Archery (+2 ranged attacks), Dual Wield (draw/stow freely; bonus attack with light weapon adds Precision), or Two-Handed (+2 damage with two-handed melee). Change on long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Land Stride
features.description: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Advantage on rolls against plants that impede movement magically.

features.name: Bounty(2)
features.description: Add proficiency bonus to tracking rolls related to your Bounty. You know the direction to your Bounty while it is on the same plane and within 1 mile.

features.name: Volley
features.description: Action: make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you choose within range (separate rolls; one attack each). Once per short rest.

features.name: Vanish into the Wild
features.description: You can Hide as a bonus action. In natural terrain, leaving no tracks and becoming invisible until you attack or cast while remaining still for 1 round (once per short rest).

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: Once per turn, treat a ranged weapon attack roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Against your Bounty, critical hits on 19-20.

features.name: Last Hunt
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute against your Bounty: attacks have advantage, Bounty damage becomes +4d6, and reducing it to 0 HP restores 4d10 HP to you.

features.name: Interrogate
features.description: Advantage on Confidence and Judgment checks to extract information. After 1 minute of questioning, know if the creature knowingly lied (Judgment contest).

features.name: Manacles
features.description: Bonus action: restrain a grappled or willing creature (escape DC = your Precision DC). While restrained this way, disadvantage on spell attacks and rolls against spell DCs.

features.name: Cutpurse's Bane
features.description: Against humanoids marked as Bounty, weapon attacks deal +1d6 and you have advantage on rolls to detect illusions and disguises.

features.name: Relentless Pursuit
features.description: Your Bounty lasts 24 hours. You ignore the first exhaustion from forced marches when pursuing it.

features.name: Verdict
features.description: Once per short rest when you hit your Bounty, it makes a Judgment roll vs Precision DC or is incapacitated until the end of its next turn and takes +2d8 damage.

features.name: Hand of the Law
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute humanoid enemies within 30 feet cannot Hide from you, your Bounty damage applies to all humanoids, and Manacles can be applied as a reaction when you hit.

features.name: Monster Lore
features.description: After observing a creature for 1 round, learn its resistances, immunities, and one special action. Advantage on Bounty attacks against aberrations, monstrosities, and undead.

features.name: Warding Trap
features.description: Action: set a trap in a 5-ft space (1 minute to hide it). First enemy to enter takes 2d8 damage (type chosen) and Speed vs Precision DC or is restrained 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Silver Edge
features.description: Your weapon attacks against shapechangers and undead count as silvered and deal +1d6.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Reaction: when an enemy within 5 feet moves away, opportunity attack with advantage; on hit speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

features.name: Bane Strike
features.description: Once per turn against a studied monster type, +2d6 damage and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Monsterbane
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute choose a creature type; your attacks against that type crit on 18-20 and ignore resistance to weapon damage.

features.name: Beast Companion
features.description: Beast companion CR 1/4+. Commands as bonus action; shares your initiative. Bond ritual 8 hours if slain.

features.name: Feral Bond
features.description: While within 30 feet of your companion, you both add +1d4 to damage against your Bounty. You can transfer HP (action) up to your Ranger level between you once per short rest.

features.name: Pack Hunt
features.description: When you hit your Bounty, your companion may use its reaction to make one attack against it.

features.name: Primal Senses
features.description: You and your companion have blindsight 10 feet and advantage on Judgment checks to detect hidden creatures.

features.name: Shared Fury
features.description: When you use Volley or Extra Attack, your companion may Dash or Attack as part of your bonus action command without spending the bonus action (once per turn).

features.name: Wild Sovereign
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your companion grows one size, gains +2 AC and Extra Attack, and Pack Hunt triggers on every hit against your Bounty.

roles.name: Reaver
roles.description: The Reaver relies on Confidence (class DC, Temper) with Endurance secondary. Spellcasting: none (Mark of Possession casts).
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed, Versatile, Reach, Great, Ranged Two-Handed, Oversized (any size)
roles.spellcasting: Half caster from level 2, Confidence; slots per Shared Frame half-caster table (top tier 6th), copied from the Wraith; spell list pending

features.name: Soul Harvest
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, gain 1 Soul (max = proficiency bonus). Bonus action: spend 1 Soul to regain 1d8 + Confidence HP. Soul Harvest(2) improves spending options.

scaling.change: Soul Harvest(2): spend 1 Soul for +1d6 on a hit; or 2 Souls to regain 2d8+Confidence

features.name: Dark Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 necrotic. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

features.name: Spellcraft(2)
features.description: You cast spells using the half-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Dread Aura
features.description: Aura 10 feet: enemies that start their turn there make a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or have disadvantage on their next attack before the start of your next turn. Soft once-per-creature-per-minute. Dread Aura(2) expands.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Soul Harvest(2)
features.description: Spend 1 Soul when you hit to deal +1d6 necrotic, or 2 Souls as a bonus action to regain 2d8 + Confidence HP.

features.name: Life Drain
features.description: When Dark Strike damages a creature, you regain HP equal to half the Dark Strike bonus dice (rounded up).

features.name: Reap
features.description: Action: melee attack against each creature within 5 feet. Separate rolls. Once per short rest.

features.name: Dread Aura(2)
features.description: Aura becomes 30 feet. Failed Judgment also deals 1d6 psychic.

features.name: Soul Furnace
features.description: At the start of combat, gain 2 Souls. Max Souls becomes proficiency bonus + 2.

features.name: Harbinger
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Dark Strike becomes +3d6, Dread Aura auto-applies disadvantage without a roll once per creature turn, and reducing a creature to 0 HP grants 2 Souls.

features.name: Veilwalk
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

features.name: Phase Shift
features.description: Reaction: when hit, gain resistance to that damage and teleport 10 feet. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Between Worlds
features.description: You can see into the ethereal within 30 feet. Attacks against ethereal creatures within reach have no disadvantage from that state.

features.name: Shade Ambush
features.description: When you Veilwalk, your next attack before the end of the turn has advantage and qualifies for Dark Strike even if already used this turn (still once for the extra trigger).

features.name: Crossroads Gate
features.description: Action: create a linked pair of gates within 60 feet for 1 minute; any creature entering one exits the other. Once per short rest.

features.name: Lord of the Crossing
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Veilwalk has unlimited uses, range 60 feet, and Phase Shift does not expend uses.

features.name: Possessed Weapon
features.description: Your weapon houses a devil. It is magical. Bonus action: for 1 minute the devil aids you (+1d4 damage; you may reroll one damage die per hit). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Infernal Armor
features.description: While Possessed Weapon is active, +1 AC and resistance to fire. When hit by melee, the attacker takes 1d4 fire.

features.name: Augment
features.description: Spend 1 Soul as a free action when you hit to add 2d6 fire or necrotic (devil's choice when bound).

features.name: Twin Pact
features.description: Once per short rest, the devil acts independently: as a reaction it makes one weapon attack using your bonuses when a creature within 5 feet attacks you.

features.name: Overtaken
features.description: Bonus action: let the devil overtake you for 1 minute — advantage on Might and Confidence, +2d6 fire on melee, must attack if able each turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Perfect Vessel
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you and the devil act in unison: Extra Attack grants one additional attack, Augment costs no Soul once per turn, and Infernal Armor reflects 2d6 fire.

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Corrupt Spell
features.description: When you cast a Reaver spell of 1st rank+, you may deal +1d6 necrotic to one target and become lightly corrupted until a short rest (Guide tracks corruption; at 3 stacks disadvantage on Judgment social rolls until long rest).

features.name: Blight Bolt
features.description: Cantrip: ranged spell attack 60 feet, 1d10 necrotic; scales Cantrip d10. On hit, target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Decay Aura
features.description: Aura 10 feet: enemies starting turn there take 1d4 necrotic. Scales Ongoing d4 every 5 from 9.

features.name: Rotting Word
features.description: Action: creature within 60 feet makes Endurance vs Confidence DC or takes 4d8 necrotic and is poisoned 1 minute. Once per short rest.

features.name: Unmaking
features.description: Once per long rest when you hit with a spell or Dark Strike, the target makes an Endurance roll vs Confidence DC; on a failure ongoing spells of 5th rank or lower on it end, and it takes +4d8 necrotic.

features.name: Herald of Ruin
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Decay Aura becomes 30 feet and 2d6, Corrupt Spell +2d6, and Blight Bolt hits all creatures in a 10-ft radius of the primary target (one attack roll vs each).

roles.name: Knight
roles.description: The Knight relies on Might (attacks, shove/override DCs, mounted features); Confidence optional for Crown Guard. Spellcasting: None.
roles.armor_prof: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy Armor, Shields
roles.weapon_prof: Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed, Ranged One-Handed, Versatile, Reach, Great

features.name: Oath of Steel
