features.description: You are proficient with heavy armor, shields, and martial weapons. As a bonus action, adopt a Guard: +1 AC until the start of your next turn, or +1d4 to one ally's AC within 5 feet until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Heavy Training
features.description: Ignore speed reduction from heavy armor. Climb and swim at full speed in heavy armor (still disadvantage on Stealth if armor imposes it).

features.name: Rally
features.description: Bonus action: you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to 1d8 + Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Rally(2) improves.

scaling.change: Rally(2): 2d8+Confidence; also end fear on affected allies

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Bulwark
features.description: While wielding a shield, +1 AC. Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack(2)
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 2 extra attacks (three times total).

features.name: Rally(2)
features.description: Rally grants 2d8 + Confidence temporary HP and ends the frightened condition on affected allies.

features.name: Unyielding
features.description: When you fail an Endurance or Might roll, you may succeed instead. Once per short rest.

features.name: Paragon
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute gain +2 AC, Rally does not expend uses, and Bulwark reactions do not expend uses.

features.name: Glory Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d6 and you or an ally within 30 feet gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Challenge
features.description: Bonus action: challenge a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. It has disadvantage on attacks against others while within 5 feet of you; you have advantage on attacks against it. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Herald's Banner
features.description: Action: plant a banner (30-ft aura, 1 minute). Allies add +1 to attack rolls. Once per short rest.

features.name: Duelist's Honor
features.description: Against your Challenge target, critical hits on 19-20 and they cannot make opportunity attacks against creatures other than you.

features.name: Valor
features.description: When an ally within 30 feet hits your Challenge target, you may use your reaction to make one melee attack against it.

features.name: Legend
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Glory Strike becomes +2d6, Challenge has unlimited uses, and Herald's Banner is always active.

features.name: Shield Wall
features.description: While wielding a shield, allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC. You can shove as a bonus action.

features.name: Intercept
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 5 feet is hit, take the hit instead (damage applies to you). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Fortress
features.description: Action: until the start of your next turn, +2 AC and resistance to a damage type you choose when you activate. Uses = Endurance modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Taunt
features.description: Bonus action: enemies within 15 feet make a Judgment roll vs Might DC or must target you with their next attack before the end of their next turn if able.

features.name: Iron Bastion
features.description: Intercept grants you resistance to the redirected damage. Shield Wall becomes +2 AC to allies within 5 feet.

features.name: Living Wall
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Intercept has unlimited range 30 feet, Fortress is permanent for the duration, and you have resistance to all damage.

features.name: Executioner
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature below half its HP maximum, deal +1d8. Against creatures at 0 HP you may choose to knock out instead of kill.

features.name: Cleave
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, make one melee attack against a different creature within reach as part of the same attack (once per turn).

features.name: Bloodied Fury
features.description: While you are below half HP, +2 to melee damage and advantage on Might rolls.

features.name: Headsman
features.description: Critical hits with melee weapons deal +2d8 and the target makes an Endurance roll vs Might DC or is frightened of you for 1 minute.

features.name: Reaping Blow
features.description: Action: one melee attack with advantage; on hit +4d8 and if the target has 50 HP or fewer after the hit it drops to 0. Once per short rest.

features.name: Kingslayer
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Executioner applies to all hits (+2d8), Cleave can chain a second time, and Reaping Blow threshold becomes 100 HP.

roles.name: Lancer
roles.description: The Lancer relies on Might (Precision optional with finesse spears). Spellcasting: None.
roles.armor_prof: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy Armor, Shields

features.name: Reach Mastery
features.description: Spears, lances, and polearms you wield have +5 feet reach if they did not already have reach, or +5 feet additional if they did (max 15 feet). Opportunity attacks with these weapons do not require a reaction when a creature enters your reach (once per turn free; further cost reaction).

features.name: Spearwork
features.description: You may use Precision for attack and damage with spears, lances, and polearms. Once per turn when you hit with such a weapon, deal +1d4.

features.name: Leap
features.description: Bonus action: jump horizontally up to your speed (or vertically half) without a running start; opportunity attacks against you during the leap have disadvantage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Leap(2) improves.

scaling.change: Leap(2): land adjacent to a creature and make one spear attack with advantage

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Impale
features.description: When you hit with a reach weapon, you may force a Might roll vs Precision DC; on a failure the target is restrained by the weapon until you withdraw it (bonus action) or they succeed on the roll at end of turn. While impaled, you cannot attack other targets with that weapon. Once per short rest.

features.name: Whirlwind
features.description: Action: one melee attack with a reach weapon against each creature of your choice within reach. Once per short rest.

features.name: Leap(2)
features.description: When you Leap, you may land within 5 feet of a creature and make one spear/polearm attack with advantage as part of the bonus action.

features.name: Skewer
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature that is Large or smaller with a reach weapon, deal +2d8 and push it 10 feet; Speed vs Precision DC negates the push.

features.name: Favor of the Monkey King
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute your spear strikes can target any creature you can see within 60 feet (the strike bridges the gap with golden reach). Attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

features.name: Dive Strike
features.description: When you Leap or fall at least 10 feet before an attack, the attack has advantage and deals +1d6.

features.name: Soaring Leap
features.description: Leap distance doubles. You take no falling damage from leaps of your own making.

features.name: Talon Grip
features.description: When you hit after a Leap, you may grapple the target (Precision contest vs Might or Precision). While grappled this way, you both remain aloft if you Leap again with them (they fall if released midair).

features.name: Sky Lance
features.description: Ranged thrown spear attack 30/90; returns to your hand after the attack. Deals Spearwork bonus.

features.name: Eagle's Eye
features.description: Advantage on Precision checks relying on sight. Once per turn ignore half cover with spear attacks.

features.name: Falling Star
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, Leap any distance within 120 feet and make Whirlwind on landing; each hit deals +2d8 and Dive Strike applies.

features.name: Coil
features.description: Bonus action: take a coiled stance until you move. Your next spear attack has advantage and deals +1d6; if it hits, you may move 10 feet without provoking.

features.name: Venom Fang
features.description: Once per turn when you hit, deal +1d4 poison and Endurance vs Precision DC or poisoned until end of its next turn.

features.name: Quick Strike
features.description: Reaction: when a creature enters your reach, make one spear attack. Uses = Precision modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Serpent Sway
features.description: While coiled or after a Coil attack, +2 AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Twin Fang
features.description: When you hit with Coil's attack, make one additional spear attack against the same target as part of that bonus action.

features.name: Viper's Tears
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Venom Fang becomes 2d6 poison and a failed Endurance roll also incapacitates until the end of the target's next turn; Coil does not require staying still.

features.name: Web Line
features.description: Bonus action: create a 30-ft line of silk between two points or to a surface; it is difficult terrain for enemies and can be climbed by you without checks. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Lasts 1 minute.

features.name: Snare
features.description: Action: creature within 30 feet makes a Speed roll vs Precision DC or is restrained by silk 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.

features.name: Eight Points
features.description: You ignore difficult terrain from webs/silk. Opportunity attacks with spears have advantage against restrained creatures.

features.name: Tangling Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit, the target's speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn (Speed vs Precision DC negates).

features.name: Silk Step
features.description: You can walk on walls and ceilings while touching silk or Web Line. Bonus action teleport up to 20 feet along your silk.

features.name: Web of Lies
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, fill a 30-ft cube within 60 feet with silk for 1 minute: enemies treat it as difficult terrain, are lightly obscured to others, and at the start of their turns make Speed vs Precision DC or are restrained until they escape.

roles.name: Songsmith
roles.description: The Songsmith relies on Confidence (spells, Inspiration, voice features). Spellcasting: Full caster, Confidence (support and control).
roles.spellcasting: Full caster, Confidence (support and control); slots per Shared Frame full-caster table

features.name: Spellcraft(1)
features.description: You cast spells using the full-caster slot table for your role level. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Confidence.

features.name: Cantrips(2)
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Verse
features.description: Bonus action: begin a Verse lasting 1 minute (you must be able to speak). Choose Courage (+1d4 to allies' attack rolls within 30 feet) or Dissonance (enemies within 30 feet subtract 1d4 from their first attack each turn). Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest. Verse(2)/(3) improve.

scaling.change: Verse(3): die 1d8; allies also gain temporary HP equal to Confidence when Verse starts

features.name: Harmony
features.description: When you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+ that targets an ally, another ally within 15 feet of them gains half the healing or +1d4 on their next attack before your next turn.

features.name: Verse(2)
features.description: Verse die becomes 1d6. Gain one additional Verse use.

features.name: Countersong
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 60 feet fails a Judgment or Confidence roll against a charm/fear effect, add your Confidence modifier to the result. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Encore
features.description: When your Verse ends, you may immediately begin a different Verse without expending a use (once per short rest).

features.name: Verse(3)
features.description: Verse die becomes 1d8. When you start a Verse, allies in range gain temporary HP equal to your Confidence modifier (min 1).

features.name: Crescendo
features.description: Once per long rest when you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+, treat it as one slot rank higher and Verse die becomes 1d10 for 1 minute.

features.name: Magnum Opus
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute both Courage and Dissonance apply, Verse does not expend uses, and allies in range add your Confidence modifier to damage rolls.

features.name: Tulip's Bloom
features.description: When you restore HP with a Songsmith spell or feature, add 1d6. Once per turn grant the target +1 AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Warm Refrain
features.description: Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Confidence HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Rebirth Hymn
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

features.name: Spring Chorus
features.description: Verse of Courage also causes allies to regain 1d4 HP at the start of their turns.

features.name: Lifesong
features.description: Action: heal three creatures within 30 feet for 3d8 + Confidence. Once per short rest.

features.name: Eternal Spring
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet automatically succeed on death rolls and regain 2d8 HP at the start of their turns.

features.name: War Hymn
features.description: Verse of Courage also adds +1d4 to allies' damage rolls.

features.name: Golden Rally
features.description: Bonus action: one ally within 30 feet gains advantage on their next attack and +1d6 damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Burning Chorus
features.description: When you deal damage with a Songsmith cantrip or spell, add +1d6 fire once per cast.

features.name: Sunfire Verse
features.description: Dissonance also deals 1d6 fire to an enemy the first time it hits an ally each turn.

features.name: Anthem
features.description: Action: allies within 30 feet gain +2 to attacks and damage for 1 minute. Once per long rest.

features.name: Marigold Blaze
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute War Hymn becomes +2d6 damage, Burning Chorus +2d6 fire, and Anthem is active.

features.name: Thorned Lullaby
features.description: Bonus action: a creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs Confidence DC or is charmed until the end of your next turn (hostile acts end it). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Dirge
features.description: Verse of Dissonance: enemies also have disadvantage on Judgment rolls while in the aura.

features.name: Wilting Note
features.description: Cantrip-like action: one creature within 60 feet takes 2d6 necrotic (Judgment vs Confidence DC halves). Scales Cantrip d6-equivalent as Burst. Uses at will.

features.name: Requiem
features.description: When a creature charmed by you takes damage from your spells, it takes +1d8 psychic and the charm does not auto-end from that damage (still ends on other allies harming it).

features.name: Mourning Song
features.description: Action: enemies within 30 feet make Judgment vs Confidence DC or are frightened for 1 minute (repeat each turn). Once per short rest.

features.name: Black Rose Elegy
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Thorned Lullaby auto-succeeds once per turn (still costs bonus action), Wilting Note deals 4d6, and frightened enemies take 2d6 psychic at the start of their turns.

roles.name: Wraith
roles.description: The Wraith relies on Intellect (class DC, Radiance) with Endurance secondary. Spellcasting: half caster (Intellect) from level 2.
roles.spellcasting: Half caster from level 2, Intellect; slots per Shared Frame half-caster table (top tier 6th); Paladin spell list; 2 cantrips from level 2 (Cleric cantrips + Grace Bolt); sigil blade is a focus for Wraith spells; spell DC 8 + proficiency + Intellect

features.name: Spellcraft(3)
features.description: You cast using a short-rest slot table: few slots that return on a short or long rest. Spell attack and spell DC use 8 + proficiency bonus + your casting stat. Casting stat: Intellect.

features.name: Grace Bolt
features.description: Cantrip action: up to two creatures within 60 feet of you and within 10 feet of each other; ranged spell attack against each. On hit 1d8 radiant + 1d4 fire. Scales: extra target or die at Grace Bolt ranks. Cantrip d8 for the radiant die.

features.name: Radiant Invocations
features.description: Learn two Radiant Invocations (Seal lists add more). Invocations modify Grace Bolt or grant at-will lesser miracles. You learn more at Radiant Invocations(2).

scaling.change: Radiant Invocations(2): learn two more; one may be greater

features.name: Siphon Grace
features.description: When you hit with Grace Bolt, regain HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1) once per turn. Siphon Grace(2) improves.

scaling.change: Siphon Grace(2): also gain temporary HP equal to number of Grace Bolt targets hit

features.name: Grace Bolt(2)
features.description: Grace Bolt deals 2d8 radiant + 1d4 fire and can target up to three creatures (each within 10 feet of at least one other target).

features.name: Radiant Invocations(2)
features.description: Learn two additional Radiant Invocations.

features.name: Grace Bolt(3)
features.description: Grace Bolt deals 3d8 radiant + 1d4 fire (up to three targets).

features.name: Siphon Grace(2)
features.description: When Grace Bolt hits, gain temporary HP equal to the number of targets hit in addition to Siphon healing.

features.name: Haloed
features.description: You shed bright light 10 feet / dim 10 feet (suppressable). Advantage on Judgment rolls against fear and possession. Once per short rest as a bonus action, end one mild curse or poison on yourself.

features.name: Grace Bolt(4)
features.description: Grace Bolt deals 4d8 radiant + 1d4 fire and can target up to four creatures.

features.name: Borrowed Miracle
features.description: Once per short rest, cast a 1st- or 2nd-rank Wraith spell without expending a slot.

features.name: Unchained
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Grace Bolt targets up to six creatures within 60 feet (no clustering required), Siphon Grace heals Intellect + proficiency bonus, and you regain one short-rest slot at the start of each of your turns (max your slot total).

features.name: Enochian Binding
features.description: Learn the Nephilim Invocation list. Bonus action: bind a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; it has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Grace-Edged
features.description: Your melee weapon attacks deal +1d4 radiant. You may use Intellect for attack and damage with simple melee weapons.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 1 extra attack (twice total).

features.name: Seal Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit a bound creature with a weapon or Grace Bolt, deal +2d6 radiant and pull it up to 10 feet toward you.

features.name: Script of Ruin
features.description: Action: a bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 radiant (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves) and is knocked prone on a failure. Once per short rest.

features.name: Nephil Ascendant
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you fight as if you had Extra Attack(2) (2 extra attacks, 3 total), Grace-Edged becomes +2d6, and Enochian Binding does not expend uses.

features.name: Burning Wings
features.description: Learn Seraphim Invocations. Bonus action: for 1 minute gain fly speed 30 feet (hover). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. While flying, Grace Bolt fire die becomes 1d6.

features.name: Holy Flame
features.description: When Grace Bolt hits, the target takes +1d6 fire at the start of its next turn unless it spends its action to extinguish (no roll).

features.name: Empowered Bolt
features.description: Once per turn, add Intellect modifier again as radiant damage to one Grace Bolt hit.

features.name: Seraph's Gaze
features.description: Action: creatures of your choice within a 30-ft cone make a Judgment roll vs Intellect DC or are blinded until the end of their next turn. Once per short rest.

features.name: Sixfold Fire
features.description: Grace Bolt may deal all fire or all radiant. When you hit three or more targets, deal +2d6 fire to each.

features.name: Throne Fire
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Burning Wings is permanent, Holy Flame becomes 2d6, and Grace Bolt gains a 15-ft radius burst option (Speed vs Intellect DC; half on success) dealing Grace Bolt damage once.

features.name: Virtue's Mend
features.description: Learn Virtue Invocations. Bonus action: touch a creature to restore 1d8 + Intellect HP. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Shared Grace
features.description: When Siphon Grace heals you, an ally within 30 feet also regains HP equal to your Intellect modifier (min 1).

features.name: Temperance
features.description: Advantage on rolls against charm and possession. Once per short rest as a reaction, grant that advantage to an ally within 30 feet for one roll.

features.name: Fortitude
features.description: When you finish a short rest, you and allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your Wraith level.

features.name: Charity
features.description: Action: transfer any number of your temporary HP to allies within 30 feet, or spend a short-rest slot to heal all allies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Intellect. Once per short rest for the slot heal.

features.name: Perfect Virtue
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Virtue's Mend does not expend uses, Shared Grace heals twice Intellect, and allies within 30 feet have resistance to necrotic and psychic.

armor.name: Umber Eclipse Targe
armor.description: Round shield with a dark disc that swallows light. Once per long rest, as a reaction to a spell attack or a spell that requires a Precision roll, you gain +5 AC and advantage on that save.

effects.name: Lightswallow Guard
effects.text: Once per short rest, as a reaction to a spell attack or a spell that requires a DEX save, gain +5 AC and advantage on that save.

armor.name: Ochrehide Jerkin
armor.description: Tanned hide stained with Ochre clay; a road-warden staple.

armor.name: Lupine Trailcoat
armor.description: Fur-trimmed leather cut for long runs in Lupine country.

armor.name: Vellari Gauze Wrap
armor.description: Layered gauze bands the Vellari wear under travel robes.

armor.name: Sablethread Doublet
armor.description: Black quilted doublet with corded seams.

armor.name: Graniar Quarry Apron
armor.description: Heavy canvas apron with slate inserts, worn by Graniar cutters.

armor.name: Skyborn Gliding Leathers
armor.description: Close-fitted leathers with webbed underarms.

armor.name: Dewlight Jerkin
armor.description: Pale leather that beads with dew at dawn. Once per long rest, when you would be blinded, you can use your reaction to ignore it until the end of your next turn.

armor.name: Cinderfoot Leathers
armor.description: Soot-dark leather from the Gehennan borderlands. You take no damage from walking on hot ground, embers or burning terrain, and you have advantage on saves against being knocked prone.

armor.name: Whisperstep Vest
armor.description: Felted vest that drinks sound. Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage if you moved at least 10 ft this turn.

armor.name: Thornmoss Wrap
armor.description: Living moss over leather; it prickles when grabbed. When a creature grapples you, it takes 1d4 piercing damage.

armor.name: Lupine Ridgehide
armor.description: Layered wolf-hide with a raised spine ridge.

armor.name: Graniar Slate Lamellar
armor.description: Thin slate plates laced in rows; it clacks.

armor.name: Ochre Drifter's Coat
armor.description: Dust-coloured greatcoat that seems to blur at the hem. Your walking speed can't be reduced by difficult terrain made of sand, mud or snow, and once per short rest you can take the Dash action as a bonus action.

effects.name: Dustblur Stride
effects.text: Nonmagical difficult terrain doesn't reduce your walking speed. Once per short rest, Dash as a bonus action; opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage until the end of that turn.

armor.name: Umbral Veilcoat
armor.description: Umber-dyed silk that pools with shadow. While in dim light or darkness you can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Once per short rest, when hit, you can use your reaction to become heavily obscured to that attacker until the start of your next turn (it has disadvantage on further attacks).

effects.name: Shadowpool Cloak
effects.text: In dim light or darkness you can Hide as a bonus action. Once per short rest, when hit, use your reaction to become heavily obscured to that attacker until the start of your next turn (it has disadvantage on further attacks). The obscurement applies to all attackers.

armor.name: Umberwood Scale
armor.description: Hardened dark-wood scales over leather.

armor.name: Vellari Lacquered Coat
armor.description: Lacquered panels on a Vellari riding coat.

armor.name: Ochre Clay Cuirass
armor.description: Fired-clay breastplate on a padded backing.

armor.name: Marchwarden Brigandine
armor.description: Canvas-covered plates riveted for border patrols.

armor.name: Saltglass Scale
armor.description: Scales of fused coastal glass. You have resistance to acid damage from every source, and advantage on saves against being poisoned.

armor.name: Stormhide Lamellar
armor.description: Hide plates from beasts of the high storms. When you are hit by a lightning attack, you can halve the damage (reaction, 1/short rest).

armor.name: Bramblewarden Coat
armor.description: Woven bramble over hide; it shifts like a hedge. You can't be pushed or pulled more than 5 ft against your will.

armor.name: Hearthcoal Brigandine
armor.description: Plates warmed from within by a coal-red lining. You suffer no penalties from extreme cold, and once per long rest you can end the frightened condition on yourself as a bonus action.

armor.name: Graniar Oathstone
armor.description: Shield cut from a stone sworn upon by Graniar elders. You have advantage on Might and Endurance rolls while the shield is held.

effects.name: Eldersworn Grip
effects.text: Advantage on STR and CON saves while the shield is held.

effects.name: Oathbound Brace
effects.text: +1 AC. One ally within 5 ft also gains advantage on STR saves. Resistance to thunder damage.

armor.name: Ochre Sunscale
armor.description: Burnished scales the colour of an Ochre noon. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when hit, you flare: the attacker is blinded until the end of its next turn (Endurance roll vs 8 + proficiency + Endurance).

effects.name: Noonflare Retort
effects.text: Twice per long rest, as a reaction when hit, flare: the attacker is blinded until the end of its next turn (CON save vs 8 + proficiency + CON).

effects.name: Sunscale Glare
effects.text: +1 AC. Resistance to radiant damage.

armor.name: Bellwether Plate
armor.description: Plate with a small bronze bell at the gorget. As a bonus action (1/short rest), each enemy within 10 ft must make a Judgment roll or have disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you until your next turn.

armor.name: Cragwall Carapace
armor.description: Rough Graniar granite plates. When you take the Dodge action you also gain temporary HP equal to your Endurance modifier.

armor.name: Graniar Stoneplate
armor.description: Hammered plates backed with flat stone, Graniar-made.

armor.name: Sable Iron Hauberk
armor.description: Blackened iron mail to the shin.

armor.name: Ochre Bulwark Harness
armor.description: Thick ochre-painted plate for siege lines.

armor.name: Gehenna Slag Mail
armor.description: Rings drawn from Gehennan slag; heavy and coarse.

armor.name: Umber Banded Coat
armor.description: Banded iron strips over dark leather.

armor.name: Vellari Gatewarden Plate
armor.description: Ceremonial plate of the Vellari gate guards.

armor.name: Ironroot Splint
armor.description: Splints grown from iron-hard roots. You have advantage on saves against being knocked prone or pushed.

armor.name: Frostfen Hauberk
armor.description: Mail rimed with frost that never melts. You suffer no penalties from extreme cold and you can't be slowed by ice or snow.

armor.name: Kite Shield
armor.description: Tapered shield for mounted work.

armor.name: Spiked Buckler
armor.description: Small shield; can catch a blade.

armor.name: Runic Targe
armor.description: Round shield etched with ward-lines.

armor.name: Tidewall Shield
armor.description: Blue-lacquered shield that sheds water. You have advantage on Precision rolls against effects you can see while this shield is raised.

armor.name: Lupine Hide Targe
armor.description: Round hide shield on a bent-wood frame.

armor.name: Graniar Slab Shield
armor.description: A cut slab of stone with a strap; brutal to carry.

armor.name: Ochre Oval Shield
armor.description: Painted oval shield of ochre-dyed planks.

armor.name: Umber Ironrim Shield
armor.description: Dark oak shield bound in iron.

armor.name: Skyborn Wingbuckler
armor.description: Feather-shaped buckler of light bone.

armor.name: Vellari Crescent Shield
armor.description: Crescent-cut shield used by Vellari cavalry.

armor.name: Thornback Buckler
armor.description: Buckler grown from a briar knot. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 piercing damage (1/turn).

armor.name: Sable Hushguard
armor.description: Felt-faced black shield; blows land dull. Once per short rest, when hit by a critical hit, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8.

armor.name: Bastion Pavise
armor.description: Tall standing shield with a fold-out brace. As a bonus action you can plant it: until you move, you and one adjacent ally gain half cover.

armor.name: Padded Cloth
armor.description: Quilted layers; quiet and light.

armor.name: Leather Harness
armor.description: Boiled leather straps over cloth.

armor.name: Hide Coat
armor.description: Thick hide; dex bonus capped at +2.

armor.name: Scale Shirt
armor.description: Overlapping scales; noisy.

armor.name: Chain Hauberk
armor.description: No dex to AC; needs strong frame.

armor.name: Plate Harness
armor.description: Full plates; max mundane protection.

armor.name: Wooden Shield
armor.description: Add as shieldMod while equipped.

armor.name: Iron Buckler
armor.description: Small shield; lighter cover.

armor.name: Travel Cloak Lining
armor.description: Reinforced lining under a traveler’s cloak.

armor.name: River Reed Wrap
armor.description: Woven reeds; light and quiet near water.

armor.name: Softsuede Vest
armor.description: Supple suede panels over the torso.

armor.name: Brigand Straps
armor.description: Layered leather straps favored by road thieves.

armor.name: Umber Silk Mail
armor.description: Dark silk with thin hidden plates.

armor.name: Scout’s Jack
armor.description: Short jacket with discreet bone stays.

armor.name: Bark Mantle
armor.description: Cured bark scales; forest hunters’ wear.

armor.name: Bone Lamellar
armor.description: Laced bone plates; light rattle.

armor.name: Ringweave Coat
armor.description: Cloth coat sewn with iron rings.

armor.name: Bronze Scale
armor.description: Warm-toned scales; flashy and loud.

armor.name: Horned Cuirass
armor.description: Hard cuirass with ceremonial horns.

armor.name: Ashen Brigandine
armor.description: Plates riveted under grey canvas.

armor.name: Iron Hauberk
armor.description: Standard iron mail to the knee.

armor.name: Splint March
armor.description: Vertical splints for long campaigns.

armor.name: Knight’s Plate
armor.description: Full harness; parade and battle.

armor.name: Obsidian Carapace
armor.description: Volcanic glass plates; brittle but hard.

armor.name: Tower Shield
armor.description: Huge shield; great cover, hard to hide.

armor.name: Gehennan Ashscale
armor.description: Grey scales that flake like cooled ash. You have resistance to fire damage. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while you are bloodied, it takes fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

effects.name: Cinderskin Rebuke
effects.text: Resistance to fire. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while you are bloodied, it takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus. The retaliation also applies while you are not bloodied, once per round.

armor.name: Sable Wolfguard Harness
armor.description: Lupine war-harness of sable steel and fur. While an ally is within 5 ft of you, you and that ally gain +1 to saving throws. Once per long rest, as a reaction to a crit against you, turn it into a normal hit.

effects.name: Packbond Guard
effects.text: While an ally is within 5 ft of you, you and that ally gain +1 to saving throws. Once per long rest, as a reaction to a crit against you, turn it into a normal hit.

effects.name: Wolfguard Brace
effects.text: +1 AC. The save bonus range is 10 ft.

armor.name: Gehennan Furnaceplate
armor.description: Plate that glows dull red at the joints. Resistance to fire damage. Once per long rest, as an action, you vent heat: creatures within 10 ft make a Precision roll (8 + proficiency + Endurance) or take 3d6 fire damage, half on a success.

effects.name: Ventheat Burst
effects.text: Resistance to fire. Once per long rest, as an action, vent heat: creatures within 10 ft make a DEX save (DC 8 + proficiency + CON) or take 4d6 fire damage, half on a success.

armor.name: Gehennan Brandshield
armor.description: Iron face scorched with a Gehennan mark. Once per short rest, when you block with your reaction, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage.

effects.name: Scorchmark Block
effects.text: Once per short rest, when you block with your reaction, the attacker takes 3d6 fire damage.

armor.name: Ochre Warden Wall
armor.description: A great rectangular shield of ochre-banded steel. Allies adjacent to you gain +1 AC against ranged attacks.

effects.name: Bannerwall Screen
effects.text: Allies within 10 ft of you gain +1 AC against ranged attacks.

armor.name: Sable Vigil Plate
armor.description: Black plate whose wearer never sleeps deeply. You can't be surprised, and you have advantage on initiative.

effects.name: Wakeful Sentinel
effects.text: You can't be surprised and have advantage on initiative. Allies within 10 ft also can't be surprised. Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

armor.name: Skyborn Windcuirass
armor.description: Light cuirass vented with feather-shaped slits. You have advantage on Stealth checks. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack.

effects.name: Ventwing Vanish
effects.text: Advantage on Shadowing checks. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack.

armor.name: Umber Mirecoat
armor.description: Dark oilcloth plates that shed water and grime. You have advantage on saves against being restrained or grappled, and once per short rest you can use a bonus action to escape a grapple automatically.

effects.name: Slipgrime Escape
effects.text: Advantage on saves against being restrained or grappled. Once per short rest, use a bonus action to escape a grapple automatically. The escape also ends being restrained.

armor.name: Umbercrown Harness
armor.description: Plate crowned with umber horns at the pauldrons. Once per short rest, when an ally within 5 ft is hit, you can use your reaction to become the target instead.

effects.name: Hornguard Intercept
effects.text: Once per short rest, when an ally within 10 ft is hit, use your reaction to move to their side without provoking and become the target instead.

armor.name: Graniar Mountainheart
armor.description: Plate carved from a single seam of mountain ore. You can't be moved against your will, and once per long rest you can reduce damage from one hit to 0 (reaction).

effects.name: Rootstone Stand
effects.text: You can't be moved against your will. Once per long rest, as a reaction, reduce damage from one hit to 0.

effects.name: Bedrock Bulwark
effects.text: +1 AC. Resistance to bludgeoning damage.

armor.name: Radiant Dawnweave
armor.description: Gold-white cloth woven by Radiant hands. Twice per long rest, when an ally within 30 ft takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half of it instead. You can't be charmed while conscious.

effects.name: Shared Burden Weave
effects.text: You can't be charmed while conscious. Twice per long rest, when an ally within 30 ft takes damage, use your reaction to take half of it instead.

effects.name: Radiant Weft
effects.text: +1 AC. You have resistance to the redirected damage.

armor.name: Radiant Haloshield
armor.description: Disc shield ringed by a faint halo. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 30 ft is hit, grant it +3 AC against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.

effects.name: Haloring Deflect
effects.text: Twice per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 30 ft is hit, grant it +3 AC against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.

effects.name: Haloed Rim
effects.text: +1 AC. Your Haloring Deflect grants +4 AC instead of +3.

armor.name: Radiant Lanternplate
armor.description: White-gold plate that hums with a held breath of light. Allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when an ally within 10 ft takes damage, they gain temporary HP equal to your level before the damage applies.

effects.name: Lanternheart Hum
effects.text: Allies within 10 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened. Twice per long rest, as a reaction when an ally within 10 ft takes damage, they gain temporary HP equal to your level before the damage applies.

effects.name: Lanternlight Shell
effects.text: +1 AC. Allies in the aura can't be frightened.

armor.name: Aegis of the Last Ember
armor.description: Plate said to hold the final ember of a fallen sun. Resistance to radiant and necrotic damage. Once per long rest, when you are reduced below half HP, you regain HP equal to twice your level and enemies within 10 ft are pushed 10 ft.

effects.name: Final Sunrise
effects.text: Resistance to radiant and necrotic damage. Once per long rest, when reduced below half HP (but not to 0), regain HP equal to twice your level and push enemies within 10 ft 10 ft away.

effects.name: Sunfall Brace
effects.text: Enemies pushed by your Last Ember surge take 4d6 radiant damage.

effects.name: Last Light Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.

armor.name: Bulwark of the Hollow Sky
armor.description: A sky-pale shield that weighs nothing. Once per long rest, as a reaction, you and allies within 10 ft are immune to all damage from one attack or effect. You can't be flanked.

effects.name: Skyhollow Shelter
effects.text: You can't be flanked. Once per long rest, as a reaction, you and allies within 10 ft take no damage from one attack or effect.

effects.name: Hollow Sky Ward
effects.text: Resistance to force damage, and your no-damage reaction covers allies within 20 ft.

effects.name: Skyweight Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.

armor.name: Coat of the Unbroken Pack
armor.description: Hide of the first Lupine pack-mother, never pierced. You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage while bloodied. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, allies within 30 ft gain temporary HP equal to your level.

effects.name: Packmother's Hide
effects.text: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage while bloodied. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, allies within 30 ft gain temporary HP equal to your level.

effects.name: Pack Rally
effects.text: Your rally grants temporary HP equal to twice your level.

effects.name: Unbroken Hide Bastion
effects.text: +2 AC.

armor.name: Sable Nightskin
armor.description: Supple armor of sable-black hide that never reflects light. Ranged attacks against you have disadvantage while you are more than 30 ft from the attacker.

effects.name: Distant Shade

personality_options.flavor: Raised by a temple that took in foundlings.

personality_options.bio: You grew up on the road with players and tricksters.

personality_options.flavor: Raised haggling at the wagons of a trading caravan.
personality_options.perk: You always know the fair price of common goods, and you buy and sell them 10% better.
personality_options.bio: You grew up haggling at the wagons of a trading caravan.

personality_options.flavor: Raised working the barges with your kin.
personality_options.perk: You gain a swim speed equal to half your speed, and you never suffer motion sickness.
personality_options.bio: You grew up working the river barges with your kin.

personality_options.flavor: Raised copying and guarding texts in an archive.
personality_options.perk: You learn two extra languages.
personality_options.bio: You grew up copying and guarding the texts of an archive.

personality_options.flavor: Raised in a hunting camp on the edge of settled land.
personality_options.perk: You have advantage on checks to track beasts.
personality_options.bio: You grew up in a hunting camp on the edge of settled land.

personality_options.flavor: Apprenticed young to a crafting guild.
personality_options.perk: You gain proficiency with one artisan's tool of your choice.
personality_options.bio: You grew up as a young apprentice in a city crafting guild.

personality_options.perk: You have advantage on saves against disease, and you can identify any poison by smell.
personality_options.bio: You grew up among the healers of a sickhouse.

personality_options.bio: You grew up inside a fort on a contested border.

personality_options.bio: You grew up alone, taught by a reclusive caster.
