personality_options.flavor: Raised among smugglers who ran goods at night.
personality_options.perk: You have advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
personality_options.bio: You grew up among smugglers who ran goods by night.

personality_options.name: Solitary
personality_options.flavor: Lives apart and reshapes themselves alone.
personality_options.perk: Alone you learned to remake yourself: your Transmute spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days apart from others, reshaping yourself alone.

personality_options.name: Protector
personality_options.flavor: Stands between others and harm.
personality_options.perk: Guarding others comes naturally: your Seal spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days standing between others and harm.

personality_options.name: Hero
personality_options.flavor: Seeks out danger to lift others up.
personality_options.perk: Lifting others up is second nature: your Bless spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days seeking out danger to lift others up.

personality_options.name: Delinquent
personality_options.flavor: Breaks every rule put in front of them.
personality_options.perk: No rule holds you for long: your Break spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days breaking every rule put in front of you.

personality_options.name: Criminal
personality_options.flavor: Works angles, deals and fixes for a living.
personality_options.perk: Every deal is a lever: your Manipulate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days working angles, deals and fixes for a living.

personality_options.name: Brawler
personality_options.flavor: Settles things head-on and hard.
personality_options.perk: You hit first and hardest: your Evoke spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days settling things head-on and hard.

personality_options.name: Con Artist
personality_options.flavor: Lives behind a string of false faces.
personality_options.perk: A false face fits you well: your Illusion spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days behind a string of false faces.

personality_options.name: Wanderer
personality_options.flavor: Lives off whatever the road provides.
personality_options.perk: The road always provides: your Conjure spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days wandering from town to town, living off the road.

personality_options.name: Artisan
personality_options.flavor: Lives to build and make things.
personality_options.perk: Your hands know how to make: your Create spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days building and making things.

personality_options.name: Grudge-Keeper
personality_options.flavor: Lives to pay back every wrong.
personality_options.perk: You never forget a wrong: your Curse spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days paying back every wrong done to you.

personality_options.name: Caretaker
personality_options.flavor: Lives looking after the sick and the weak.
personality_options.perk: Mending others is your craft: your Restore spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days looking after the sick and the weak.

personality_options.name: Beastkeeper
personality_options.flavor: Lives with animals and calls them kin.
personality_options.perk: Your kin answer when called: your Summon spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days among animals you call kin.

personality_options.name: Commander
personality_options.flavor: Lives to lead and be obeyed.
personality_options.perk: Others are used to obeying you: your Subjugate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days leading others and being obeyed.

personality_options.name: Enforcer
personality_options.flavor: Keeps others in line by holding them down.
personality_options.perk: You know how to hold someone down: your Bind spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days keeping others in line by holding them down.

personality_options.name: Free Spirit
personality_options.flavor: Lives unbound by ties or promises.
personality_options.perk: Nothing keeps you tied: your Release spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days unbound by ties or promises.

personality_options.name: Ravager
personality_options.flavor: Lives by tearing down whatever stands.
personality_options.perk: Ruin follows in your wake: your Destroy spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days tearing down whatever still stands.

personality_options.name: Confident
personality_options.flavor: Sure of their own strength.
personality_options.perk: Certainty fuels your force: your Evoke spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your confident outlook leaves you sure of your own strength.

personality_options.name: Defiant
personality_options.flavor: Refuses any limit set on them.
personality_options.perk: Limits exist to be broken: your Break spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your defiant outlook refuses any limit set on you.

personality_options.name: Hopeful
personality_options.flavor: Believes things will turn out well.
personality_options.perk: Your faith in good outcomes shows: your Bless spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your hopeful outlook tells you things will turn out well.

personality_options.name: Secretive
personality_options.flavor: Shows no one who they really are.
personality_options.perk: Hiding is habit: your Illusion spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your secretive outlook shows no one who you really are.

personality_options.name: Curious
personality_options.flavor: Always wants to see what comes next.
personality_options.perk: Your wonder calls things forth: your Conjure spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your curious outlook always wants to see what comes next.

personality_options.name: Calculated
personality_options.flavor: Weighs every move before making it.
personality_options.perk: Every move is planned: your Manipulate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your calculated outlook weighs every move before you make it.

personality_options.name: Visionary
personality_options.flavor: Sees what could be built.
personality_options.perk: You see what could be: your Create spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your visionary outlook sees what could be built.

personality_options.name: Cautious
personality_options.flavor: Guards against every risk.
personality_options.perk: You shut every door behind you: your Seal spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your cautious outlook guards against every risk.

personality_options.name: Bitter
personality_options.flavor: Feels the world owes them.
personality_options.perk: Your resentment takes shape: your Curse spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your bitter outlook says the world owes you.

personality_options.name: Modest
personality_options.flavor: Thinks little of themselves, much of others.
personality_options.perk: You give more than you take: your Restore spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your modest outlook on life leaves you happy with what you have.

personality_options.name: Devoted
personality_options.flavor: Defines themselves by who they serve or stand with.
personality_options.perk: Those you serve answer you: your Summon spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your devoted outlook defines you by who you serve and stand with.

personality_options.name: Proud
personality_options.flavor: Sees themselves above others.
personality_options.perk: You expect others to bow: your Subjugate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your proud outlook sets you above others.

personality_options.name: Self-Loathing
personality_options.flavor: Wishes they were someone else.
personality_options.perk: You long to be someone else: your Transmute spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your self-loathing outlook wishes you were someone else.

personality_options.name: Greedy
personality_options.flavor: Wants to hold on to everything.
personality_options.perk: What you grab, you keep: your Bind spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your greedy outlook wants to hold on to everything.

personality_options.name: Carefree
personality_options.flavor: Lets nothing weigh on them.
personality_options.perk: You let everything go: your Release spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your carefree outlook lets nothing weigh on you.

personality_options.name: Nihilistic
personality_options.flavor: Sees nothing worth keeping.
personality_options.perk: Nothing is worth keeping: your Destroy spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your nihilistic outlook sees nothing worth keeping.

primordial_blessings.name: Steady Bulwark
primordial_blessings.prerequisite: proficiency with medium or heavy armor or a shield
primordial_blessings.description: +1 AC while wearing armor or holding a shield.

primordial_blessings.name: Swiftfoot
primordial_blessings.description: +10 ft walking speed; difficult terrain costs no extra movement on your first 10 ft each turn.

primordial_blessings.name: Kindred Rally
primordial_blessings.description: Bonus action: up to 3 allies within 30 ft gain temp HP = 5 + your level ÷ 2.

primordial_blessings.name: Iron Resolve
primordial_blessings.description: +1 to one score; gain proficiency in a save you lack.

primordial_blessings.name: Unshaken
primordial_blessings.description: Advantage on saves against charmed, frightened and stunned.

primordial_blessings.name: Deadeye Draw
primordial_blessings.description: Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover, and long range doesn't give disadvantage.

primordial_blessings.name: Spell Edge
primordial_blessings.description: Once per turn, add your spellcasting modifier to one damage roll of a spell or cantrip.

primordial_blessings.name: Elemental Bite
primordial_blessings.description: Choose a damage type (fire, cold, lightning, acid, thunder, radiant, necrotic). Your damage of that type ignores resistance, and 1s on its damage dice count as 2s.

primordial_blessings.name: Crushing Momentum
primordial_blessings.description: After moving 15 ft straight toward a target, your first melee hit deals +1d8 and pushes it 5 ft.

primordial_blessings.name: Finishing Blow
primordial_blessings.description: Once per turn, +1d10 damage to a creature that is below half its HP max.

primordial_blessings.name: Overwhelm
primordial_blessings.description: When you hit the same creature with two attacks in one turn, the second hit deals +2d6.

primordial_blessings.name: Gravecaller
primordial_blessings.description: Action: ask one question of a corpse dead less than 10 days; it answers truthfully in up to 5 words.

primordial_blessings.name: Death's Margin
primordial_blessings.description: Death saves succeed on 9+; when you're stabilized you regain 1 HP.

primordial_blessings.name: Veilsight
primordial_blessings.description: You see invisible creatures within 10 ft, and once per long rest gain truesight 60 ft for 1 minute (bonus action).

primordial_blessings.name: Paired Edge
primordial_blessings.description: Off-hand attacks add your ability modifier to damage and can use non-light one-handed weapons.

primordial_blessings.name: Bleeding Cut
primordial_blessings.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, the target bleeds for 1d6 at the start of its turns until it or an ally uses an action (Mending DC = blessing DC).

primordial_blessings.name: Mender's Touch
primordial_blessings.description: Action: a creature you touch regains 1d8 + Proficiency Bonus + the creature's level ÷ 4 HP.

primordial_blessings.name: Night-Eyed
primordial_blessings.description: Darkvision 60 ft (or +30 ft if you have it). Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on Awareness.

primordial_blessings.name: Heavy Hand
primordial_blessings.prerequisite: proficiency with a heavy or versatile weapon
primordial_blessings.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a two-handed or versatile weapon held in two hands, +Proficiency Bonus damage.

primordial_blessings.name: Warding Word
primordial_blessings.description: Reaction when an ally within 30 ft is hit: it gains +Proficiency Bonus AC against that attack (can turn it into a miss).

primordial_blessings.name: Many Faces
primordial_blessings.description: Action: change your appearance (not size) for 1 hour; Knowledge (blessing DC) to see through it.

primordial_blessings.name: Trickster's Feint
primordial_blessings.description: Bonus action: make a Misdirection check against a creature's Awareness; on a success your next attack against it this turn has advantage and it can't make opportunity attacks against you.

primordial_blessings.name: Hearthblood
primordial_blessings.description: Max HP +2 per level (retroactive). When you spend Hit Dice, add your Endurance modifier once more per die.

primordial_blessings.name: Second Breath
primordial_blessings.description: +1 Endurance. Once per short rest, when you start your turn below half HP, regain 2d6 + Endurance modifier HP (no action).

primordial_blessings.name: Ever-Watchful
primordial_blessings.description: +Proficiency Bonus to initiative; you can't be surprised while conscious.

primordial_blessings.name: Keen Wits
primordial_blessings.description: +1 Intellect, Judgment or Confidence; proficiency in one skill and one tool.

primordial_blessings.name: Silver Tongue
primordial_blessings.description: Proficiency in Diplomacy or Misdirection (expertise if already proficient). Once per long rest, reroll a failed Confidence check.

runes.name: Keen Rune
runes.effect: +1 to attack rolls with this weapon.

runes.name: Lantern Rune
runes.effect: Sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 ft more; on or off as a bonus action.

runes.name: Anchor Rune
runes.effect: The item can't be disarmed or forcibly taken from its wielder while they're conscious.

runes.name: Homing Rune
runes.effect: A thrown weapon returns to the thrower's hand after the attack; ammunition fired is recovered after combat. (Thrown weapons or ranged weapons with ammunition.)

runes.name: Dusksight Rune
runes.effect: The wearer gains darkvision 30 ft (+30 ft if they already have it). (Worn gear.)

runes.name: Fleet Rune
runes.effect: +5 ft walking speed. (Armor or worn gear.)

runes.name: Warding Rune
runes.effect: Resistance to one damage type chosen when you inscribe it (not bludgeoning, piercing or slashing). (Armor, shield or worn gear.)

runes.name: Hush Rune
runes.effect: The item makes no noise; armor with it doesn't impose disadvantage on Stealth.

runes.name: Mending Rune
runes.effect: The item repairs itself in 1 minute; once per long rest, its wearer or wielder reduces one hit's damage by 1d6 + Intellect modifier (reaction).

species.name: Igni
species.description: Ember-skinned people of Caldera's volcanic south, with cracks of molten light in their skin. They are cousins of the wyrmkin, not dragon-blooded themselves.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Heatborn
traits.description: You ignore the effects of extreme heat.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

traits.name: Flare
traits.description: Creatures within 5 ft of you make a Endurance roll or are blinded until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Ember Touch
traits.description: When you hit with a melee attack, deal an extra 1d6 fire damage.

traits.name: Molten Veins
traits.description: When a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 fire damage.

species.name: Human
species.description: You are ok sometimes

traits.name: Practiced
traits.description: +1 to one skill you are already proficient in.

traits.name: Jack of Trades
traits.description: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Second Wind of Will
traits.description: Reroll one failed ability check or save; must use the new roll.

species.name: Quillary
species.description: Hedgehog-like small folk with spines down their backs. They are stubborn burrowers who are very hard to grab.

traits.name: Burrower
traits.description: 10 ft burrowing speed through loose earth and sand.

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.description: Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Spines
traits.description: A creature that grapples you or hits you with an unarmed strike takes 1d4 piercing damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Curl Up
traits.description: When you are attacked, gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn, but your speed becomes 0.

species.name: Dross
species.description: Blue-gray coastal people of Atheria's shores, with webbed hands and gill marks. They are sailors and traders by trade.

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from cold damage.

traits.name: Trader's Tongue
traits.description: +2 to Diplomacy.

traits.name: Tidecall
traits.description: A 15 ft line of water pushes each creature in it 10 ft away from you. A Might roll negates the push.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water, and you have a 30 ft swim speed.

traits.name: Deckhand
traits.description: +2 to Presence.

species.name: Radiant
species.description: Folk born with starlight in their blood. Seams of living gold light run beneath their skin like veins of ore, and the light flares brighter with emotion. Eldridian lore says the first Radiants were born where falling stars struck the earth. They have no wings; their gift is inner light. They are warm, steady protectors who see it as their duty to stand where the dark is deepest.

traits.name: Starflare
traits.description: Your light bursts out. Each hostile creature within 10 ft makes a Endurance roll or is blinded until the end of your next turn, and you gain temporary HP equal to your level.

traits.name: Radiant Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from radiant damage.

traits.name: Steady Glow
traits.description: +2 to Awareness.

traits.name: Kindle
traits.description: When you hit a creature, deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage. The die becomes 2d6 at level 10.

traits.name: Inner Light
traits.description: Your veins shed dim light in a 10 ft radius. As a bonus action, you can make it bright light or dim it completely.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: You have an affinity for tools, and grew up at sea.

traits.name: Quick Fix
traits.description: Repair a broken object or give a creature 1d6 temp HP by patching gear.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Sea Legs
traits.description: +2 to Balance on ships or unstable footing; swim speed equal to walking speed.

traits.name: Toolwise
traits.description: Proficiency with two tools of your choice; add double proficiency with one.

species.name: Ouros
species.description: You have a draconic appearance, and the ability to breath fire

traits.name: Scaled Hide
traits.description: When not wearing armor, AC = 13 + Precision modifier.

traits.name: Draconic Presence
traits.description: +2 to Dominance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

traits.name: Fire Breath
traits.description: 15-ft cone, Precision roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Endurance), fire damage, half on success. Damage rises to 3d6 at 5, 4d6 at 11, 5d6 at 17.

species.name: Ent
species.description: Folk grown from the roots of the Tree of Life. Bark-skinned, with leaves for hair, they are slow, patient, and hard to move.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Sunmend
traits.description: While in sunlight, regain 1d8 + your level HP.

traits.name: Nature Kin
traits.description: +2 to Botany.

traits.name: Barkskin
traits.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + Precision modifier. You can still use a shield.

traits.name: Rooted
traits.description: Advantage on checks and saves against being shoved, moved against your will, or knocked prone.

species.name: Dawn Elf
species.description: You have bright green eyes, and attunement to nature.

traits.name: Wildborn
traits.description: +2 to Botany.

traits.name: Rootbind
traits.description: One creature within 30 ft makes a Might roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Judgment) or is restrained by roots until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Green Sight
traits.description: Advantage on Botany checks to track and on Awareness checks in forests or wilds.

species.name: Vespar
species.description: Pale-blue folk with storm-white hair that is never still, even when the air is calm. They are said to be children of the high winds above Eldridia's clouds, carried down to the world on the first storm. Skyborn are wingless; the wind itself lifts them. Cheerful, restless wanderers and rescuers, they believe no one should ever be left behind.

traits.name: Windreader
traits.description: +2 to Awareness.

traits.name: Windborne Flight
traits.description: The wind lifts you, giving you a 30 ft flying speed for 1 minute. You must wear light or no armor. At level 10 this becomes permanent while you wear light or no armor.

traits.name: Gust
traits.description: Push a creature within 15 ft up to 10 ft away from you (Might roll negates), or move yourself 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Lightning Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from lightning damage.

traits.name: Featherfall
traits.description: Fall no faster than 60 ft per round and take no falling damage.

species.name: Morvyne
species.description: Raven-feathered humanoids who carry messages, trade in secrets, and are said to keep watch over the dead.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

traits.name: Secret Keeper
traits.description: +2 to Knowledge.

traits.name: Gliding Wings
traits.description: Fall no faster than 60 ft per round, take no falling damage, and glide 2 ft horizontally for every 1 ft you fall.

traits.name: Deathwatch
traits.description: Sense whether a creature within 30 ft is dying, undead, or recently dead.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: +2 to Misdirection. You can perfectly mimic any voice or sound you have heard. A listener can see through it with an Awareness check against your Misdirection.

species.name: Gemine
species.description: Tall, slow mountain folk who look carved from living granite. They live for centuries and forget nothing.

traits.name: Long Memory
traits.description: +2 to Memory.

traits.name: Stoneskin
traits.description: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Granite Body
traits.description: When you take damage, reduce it by 1d8 + your Endurance modifier.

traits.name: Unmoving
traits.description: Advantage on saves and checks against being shoved, knocked prone, or moved.

species.name: Vantus
species.description: Survivors of Hollow exposure. Gaunt, with pale gray eyes and patches of their bodies gone hollow, they carry something empty inside them that the living find unsettling.

traits.name: Hollow Stare
traits.description: One creature within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Confidence) or is frightened until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Unfed
traits.description: You don't need to eat or drink for up to 7 days.

traits.name: Hollow Hunger
traits.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your level.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

traits.name: Emptied Vessel
traits.description: Advantage on saves against disease and poison.

species.name: Lumen
species.description: Slender butterfly fae with large, brilliant wings whose patterns are unique to each one, like a fingerprint. Unlike the moth-winged Wyrdlings of the ruins, Lumenwings are sunlit folk of flowering groves: dazzling, flighty, and drawn to color and life.

traits.name: Radiant Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from radiant damage.

traits.name: Grace
traits.description: +2 to Showmanship.

traits.name: Butterfly Flight
traits.description: 30 ft flying speed while wearing light or no armor and not carrying a heavy load.

traits.name: Dazzling Wings
traits.description: One creature within 15 ft that can see you makes a Endurance roll or is blinded until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Bloomtouch
traits.description: Touch a creature to restore 1d6 + your level HP.

species.name: Uron
species.description: You have large claws, and a bear like appearance

traits.name: Mauling Roar
traits.description: Creatures of your choice within 15 ft make a Judgment roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Endurance) or are frightened until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

traits.name: Hulking Grip
traits.description: +2 to Presence. Count as one size larger for carrying, pushing, and grapples.

traits.name: Bear Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons dealing 1d6 slashing; use Might.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Orcs came to Lys under King Barathos, when the kindest of the Alterian kings opened the realm's borders. They came as workers, soldiers, and settlers, and many earned their place the hard way, through the Second Great War and the long Civil Wars that followed. Strong, broad, and hard to kill, orcs are known in Lys for loyalty to whoever treats them fairly, and long memories for whoever doesn't. Where they came from before Lys is a story each clan tells differently.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Thick-Boned
traits.description: You count as one size larger for carrying, pushing, dragging and lifting, and you have proficiency in Presence.

traits.name: Breaker's Charge
traits.description: Move up to your speed toward an enemy you can see; your next melee hit this turn deals +1d6.

traits.name: Bone-Shaker Roar
traits.description: Each creature of your choice within 15 ft makes a Judgment roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Endurance) or has disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Hard to Fell
traits.description: When you drop to 0 HP but aren't killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead.

species.name: Morrow Elf
species.description: You have bright red eyes, pale to dark skin, and have an affinity for mountainous terrain

traits.name: Stone Sense
traits.description: +2 to Awareness.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from cold damage.

traits.name: Red Gaze
traits.description: One creature within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Confidence) or has disadvantage on its next attack against you.

traits.name: Mountain-Born
traits.description: +2 to Presence when climbing; ignore difficult terrain from snow, ice, or rock.

species.name: Wyrdling
species.description: Small, moth-winged fae folk with glowing eyes. They drift around ruins and old magic.

traits.name: Old Magic Sense
traits.description: Sense the presence and location of magic within 30 ft until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Moth Wings
traits.description: You have a 30 ft flying speed while wearing light armor or no armor. You can't fly while carrying more than half your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Dust Veil
traits.description: Become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.

traits.name: Arcana Kin
traits.description: +2 to Arcana.

species.name: Gehennan
species.description: People born with devil blood, each bloodline believed to descend from a devil house of Gehenna. Glowing grooves mark their skin, and their irises share the color of the dark magic in their veins: red, purple, gold, or orange. They do not age and die only if struck down. Atheria's paladins persecute them on sight.

traits.name: Vein Line
traits.description: Choose your vein color at character creation. It sets your eye and marking color, your resistance, and your Veinfire. Red: fire. Purple: psychic. Gold: force. Orange: acid.

traits.name: Kin-Sense
traits.description: +2 to Awareness. You also know whether a creature you can see within 30 ft is a devil or is bound to one.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Devil's Endurance
traits.description: When you take damage, reduce it by 1d10 + your level.

traits.name: Ageless Blood
traits.description: You don't age and can't die of old age, and magic can't age you.

traits.name: Veinfire
traits.description: Your grooves and eyes flare. The next time you hit a creature before the end of your turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage of your Vein Line's type, plus its rider. The die becomes 2d6 at level 10. Red: the target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn. Purple: the target has disadvantage on its next save against you before the end of your next turn. Gold: you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Orange: the target's speed drops by 10 ft until the end of its next turn.

species.name: Lupine
species.description: Loyal dog folk who live in packs, with looks that follow their breed lines. A Lupine might be a sturdy mastiff, a lean greyhound, a fluffy husky, a powerful rottweiler, a shepherd, or a hound.

traits.name: Pack Loyalty
traits.description: When a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 ft of you, impose disadvantage on that attack roll.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: +2 to Awareness. Advantage on smell-based checks.

traits.name: Howl
traits.description: Allies within 30 ft who can hear you gain 1d4 temporary HP and advantage on their next save against fear.

traits.name: Breed Line
traits.description: Choose a breed at character creation. Mastiff: +1 HP per level. Greyhound: +10 ft speed. Husky: cold resistance. Rottweiler: bite 1d6 + Might (bonus action, 1 per short rest). Shepherd: +2 Awareness. Hound: track by scent across up to a day-old trail.

species.name: Vellari
species.description: Fox folk of the Wildlands with two to five tails, quick, curious, and natural trackers. Each Vellari is born into one of eight gem lines, which sets their fur color: Opal (white, the classic look), Onyx (black), Amethyst (purple), Topaz (orange), Quartz (clear crystal), Emerald (green), Ruby (red), or Sapphire (blue).

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If you move at least 20 ft straight toward a creature and then hit it with a melee attack on the same turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage.

traits.name: Gem Lineage
traits.description: Choose your gem line at character creation. It sets your fur color and gives resistance to one damage type: Opal radiant, Onyx necrotic, Amethyst psychic, Topaz lightning, Quartz force, Emerald poison, Ruby fire, Sapphire cold.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Keen Nose
traits.description: +2 to Botany. Advantage on checks to track by scent.

traits.name: Quickfoot
traits.description: Take the Disengage action.

species.name: Halfling
species.description: You are known for being able to fit into small spaces, and have an affinity for slight of hand

traits.name: Nimble Fingers
traits.description: +2 to Finesse.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Slip Away
traits.description: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

traits.name: Squeeze Through
traits.description: Move through spaces as small as 6 inches without slowing down; can move through larger creatures' spaces.

species.name: Dusk Elf
species.description: Elves of Sable, the primordial dragon of death. Black-skinned with bright purple-to-indigo eyes and a faint spectral shimmer, they walk calmly at the edge between life and its ending.

traits.name: Veil of Sable
traits.description: When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, halve that damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

traits.name: Deathsight
traits.description: You can see invisible spirits and undead within 30 ft.

traits.name: Grave Calm
traits.description: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

traits.name: Spectral Step
traits.description: Teleport up to 15 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

species.name: Homunculi
species.description: Artificial souls created by alchemists seeking immortality. Most are considered failed experiments and treated poorly, but some are treated as family. Their skin is ivory and porcelain-like, ringed with fine gold seams at the wrists, elbows and shoulders, and their soul is a sentient glossy black liquid that drifts around them in ribbons and droplets. They are rare, and most can blend into normal society. Languages: Trade plus one language of the player's choice.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Remold
traits.description: Minor remold (bonus action, at will): change your face and build within your current size: features, skin markings and colour, hair, eyes, voice pitch, height (up to 1 ft) and frame. Full remold (action, 1 per short rest; Proficiency Bonus per long rest from level 11): also change size between Small and Medium (speed 25/30 ft; a size change ends after 1 hour) or copy a specific Humanoid you saw clearly for 1 minute in the last 24 hours. Only your body changes, not your gear; armor fitted to your old size gives no AC until you change back. You can't change creature type, limbs, senses or statistics. A remold ends when you remold again, choose to, or drop to 0 HP. Advantage on Misdirection checks to pass as someone else while remolded. A suspicious creature can use its action for an Awareness check against DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Confidence to see through it.

traits.name: Soul Tide
traits.description: When a creature you can see within 5 ft hits you with an attack, your soul-liquid lashes out: reduce the damage by 1d6 + your Endurance modifier (minimum 1).

traits.name: Liquid Reach
traits.description: Your soul-liquid can carry out simple tasks within 5 ft: lift or hold an object of 5 lb or less, open an unlocked door or container, or pass an item to an adjacent ally. It can't attack, wield a weapon or activate magic items. Using it costs your free object interaction.

traits.name: Unfed Vessel
traits.description: You don't need to eat, drink or sleep. You go still for 4 hours to gain the benefit of a long rest, staying aware of your surroundings. Advantage on saves against being poisoned.

species.name: Dusk-veined
species.description: Purple veins, Purple Magic (Weaken). Resistance to psychic damage. Veinfire deals psychic; the target has disadvantage on its next save against you.

species.name: Oathveined
species.description: Gold veins, Yellow Magic (Strengthen). Resistance to force damage. Veinfire deals force; you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

species.name: Rustveined
species.description: Orange veins, Orange Magic (Hinder). Resistance to acid damage. Veinfire deals acid; the target's speed drops by 10 ft.

species.name: Wrathveined
species.description: Red veins, Red Magic (Offense). Resistance to fire damage. Veinfire deals fire; the target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn.

species.name: Bloodhound
species.description: A keen-nosed hound. Track by scent across a trail up to a day old.

species.name: Greyhound
species.description: A lean, fast breed. +10 ft speed.

species.name: Husky
species.description: A fluffy breed from the cold. Resistance to cold damage.

species.name: Mastiff
species.description: A sturdy, heavy-set breed. +1 HP per level.

species.name: Rottweiler
species.description: A powerful breed. Bite: 1d6 + Might as a bonus action, 1 per short rest.

species.name: Shepherd
species.description: A watchful herding breed. +2 Awareness.

species.name: Amethyst

species.name: Emerald
species.description: Green fur. Resistance to poison damage.

species.name: Moss Agate
species.description: Frosted white crystal fur veined with dark-green moss agate. Resistance to acid damage.

species.name: Onyx
species.description: Black fur. Resistance to necrotic damage.

species.name: Opal
species.description: Pearly white fur, the classic Vellari look. Resistance to radiant damage.

species.name: Quartz

species.name: Ruby

species.name: Sapphire
species.description: Blue fur. Resistance to cold damage.

species.name: Topaz
species.description: Orange fur. Resistance to lightning damage.
